projects.description:
Chog Track: a skill game where your Chog NFT is the racer.

Stake USDC against your Chog, run a seeded obstacle course as that Chog, and the week's top three split the prize pot 50/30/20. 

Every run writes a tamper-evident record, and the Proof page re-simulates any record from the published course seed and its input tape, so the score that counts is the score anyone can recompute, right in the browser, without trusting anyone.

What is new: the NFT is the playable unit, not a badge. The runner is rendered from the Chog's real IPFS metadata, the same seed produces the same course for everyone, and results are auditable. Paste a run record into the Proof page and it rebuilds the course and replays every one of your button presses through the exact simulation the game used: green when the numbers recompute, loud and specific when they do not. 
On top of that: live replays against the ghost of the best run, a per-Chog career page, tips, and weekly rounds.


WHY CHOG MATTERS
The Chog NFT is the core of every layer:
1. The racer IS a Chog. Your Chog's real image and traits are the character on the track.
2. The entry is attached to a Chog. Your stake goes against that specific Chog on the leaderboard.
3. The history belongs to Chogs. Career, ladder, replays, and run records are all per Chog.
4. Anyone can play. No Chog? Mint a Test Drive mirror, clearly labelled with no ownership claim. Own the Chog? Sign once and mint a verified mirror with a signature that proves mainnet ownership.
Take the Chog away and there is no racer, no entry, and no board. The game does not exist without it.

projects.title: Chog studio
projects.description:
Chog Studio is a comic and meme creation tool built for holders of the Chog Genesis NFT collection on the Monad blockchain. If you own a Chog, you connect your wallet, and the app lets you turn your NFT into the star of a comic strip.

The idea is simple. NFT communities run on memes and visual storytelling, but most people don't have Photoshop or design skills. Chog Studio solves that by giving every holder a purpose-built editor that works right in the browser.

 

You also have access to supporting characters from the Chog Genesis collection. Drop them into panels alongside your hero to create scenes with multiple characters reacting to each other. Every panel and every page can have its own background color, chosen from a set of quiet tones that keep the focus on the art and the words.

When your comic is done, you export it as a PNG image — high resolution, ready to post on Twitter, Discord, or anywhere. You can also save the project as a JSON file to come back and edit later, or share it with someone else who can import it into their own studio.

One thing Chog Studio never does is touch the original art. There is no AI anywhere in the tool. It does not redraw your NFT, apply filters, generate backgrounds, or write dialogue for you. The art that appears in your comic is the exact same art from the collection. What you own is what you see.

There are no gas fees and no signatures to sign. The app never writes to the blockchain — it only reads public data to verify ownership. Your comics are saved on your device and belong entirely to you.

Chog Studio was built because every Chog deserves a story, and now every holder has the tool to tell it.

projects.title: CHOG KINGDOM
projects.description:
Chog Kingdom — multiplayer board games for the Chog community on Monad
Live at https://chogkingdom.xyz

WHAT IT IS
Chog Kingdom is a mobile-first, browser-based arena of short multiplayer games built for the Chog NFT community on Monad. Friends open a private room, share a six-character code or invite link, and play a live match of 2 to 6 players in a few minutes, on phone or desktop, with nothing to install. Anyone can play right away as a guest; connecting a wallet that holds a Chog turns that NFT into your character and unlocks extra, stronger abilities. Three games are live today, all sharing one platform: one identity, one profile, one ladder.

THE GAMES
Chog Race — a race to the finish across a 28-tile track. Roll, land on Boost and Setback tiles, and draw from a deck of chaos cards: Pump and FOMO to surge ahead, Airdrop to roll again, Whale to swap places, Reverse to push everyone back, Rug and Liquidated to attack, and HODL to block an attack aimed at you. Attacks open a short reply window, so defending is a real decision. First Chog to the finish wins; a Degen Score rewards the players who landed the most attacks.

Chog Life — a Web3 "game of life" on a 36-tile board. Every player starts with 100 MON. Tiles bring airdrops, market swings, rug pulls and liquidations, and at each fork you choose the Safe lane or the Degen lane and stake MON on it. Your portfolio tracks liquid MON, assets, bonuses and debt; the richest Chog at the end wins.

Chog Royale — five fast rounds of hidden cards. Everyone picks a card at the same time (Pump, Rug Pull, Diamond Hands, Whale Swap, Airdrop, Chaos, or HODL), aims it at an opponent if needed, and locks it in. Each round has a market event (Meme Hype, Market Crash, Whale Incoming, Community Airdrop) that changes the payoffs. Then the table reveals every play in order with an animated reveal: cards flip, rugs fly to their targets, balances count up or down. The biggest MON bag after five rounds wins, in about three to five minutes.

HOW THE NFT MATTERS
- Wallet sign-in: connect any browser wallet (EIP-6963 discovery, no third-party SDK) and sign a Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) message. It is a one-time, domain-bound, expiring challenge, never a transaction, and costs no gas.
- Your Chogs as characters: "My Chogs" reads ownership live from Monad mainnet (a Multicall3 ownerOf scan of the official collection), shows each Chog's art and traits you pick one to play as.
- Ownership is checked live when a match starts, so you can only play as a Chog you hold right now.
- Holder abilities: every player chooses one ability per match from a standard set (for example Shield and Card Vision in
Chog Race). Players using a Chog NFT also unloble Dice and Freeze in Chog Race, Double Diceand Tax the Rich in Chog Life, Fresh Mint and Insider Info in Chog Royale. Their strength scales with the Chog's Tier trait (Base through Legendary), so rarer Chogs play stronger.
- Collector badges (Holder, Collector, Patron,ld, shown in rooms and on the ladder.
- Guests are welcome: no wallet is needed to play, which lowers the barrier for newcomers and gives holders a reason to show their Chogs.

PROGRESSION AND COMMUNITY
- Profiles with display name, avatar or uploadns.
- XP per match and for each opponent beaten, with all-time and monthly-season leaderboards per game and overall (the
Ladder).
- Achievements across games: First Match, First Win, Regular, Veteran, Champion, Explorer (play two different games), and Full Degen for a perfect Degen Score.
- Detailed results screens per game: places, Mded and blocked.
- Original theme music plus a track per game, with smooth crossfades.
- Terms, privacy, and reporting of inappropriate profile photos with operator moderation.

FAIR, REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER
- Server-authoritative rules: the server rolls the cards, and validates every move, soclients can't cheat or see hidden information. Each player receives only their own view (your hand stays private).
- Real-time sync over WebSockets (SignalR), wiatic reconnect and a resume banner if you dropout.
- Turn timers and AFK handling keep matches mo default, repeated absence forfeits, and everygame has a time cap.
- Simultaneous rounds (Chog Royale) resolve once everyone has locked in or at the deadline.
- One shared engine for rooms, turns, rounds,  games plug in without changing the platform.

DESIGN AND ACCESSIBILITY
Designed for 375px phones first and scaling up to wide desktop boards: illustrated tracks with animated cars and dice, a card-table layout for Royale, large tap targets, full keyboard support, screen-reader text for every board, and
reduced-motion support.

TECHNOLOGY
- Frontend: Angular 22 single-page app (standalone, zoneless), Nx monorepo.
- Backend: .NET 8 API with SignalR, PostgreSQLrow-level locking for concurrent actions, anddatabase constraints that back the game rules.
- Monad integration: an in-house JSON-RPC clienership, IPFS metadata normalization with aPostgres cache across gateways, and SIWE sign-in. No private keys or secrets in code.
- Operations: Docker Compose on a single VM behind nginx with HTTPS (Let's Encrypt), HSTS and IPv6; encrypted nightly database backups copied off-site; health checks, uptime monitoring, Prometheus-style metrics and structured logs.
- Quality: hundreds of automated backend and frontend tests, including full-match simulations used to balance each game,
cross-game regression tests that play all three checklist run before every deployment. CIruns on GitHub Actions.

STATUS
v1.0.0 launched on 2026-10-20 with Chog Life alder abilities and music, and v1.2.0 broughtChog Royale live on 2026-10-22. All three games are playable now at chogkingdom.xyz, by guests and Chog holders alike.

WHAT'S NEXT
More games on the same engine, trait-based abilities mapped to the collection's traits, match history, and community events such as seasonal tournaments on the Ladder.

WHY IT MATTERS
Chog Kingdom gives Chog holders something fun r: their Chogs become playable characters withreal (but fair) advantages, and every match is a quick, social, crypto-flavored game that newcomers can join in seconds
without a wallet.

projects.title: Dybbo
projects.description:
Dybbo: possess any Chog for a few minutes and pay the holder.


There are 1,969 Chog Genesis and about 982 people who own one. Monad has more than 4.3 million wallets. The difference is the audience almost every Chog app leaves out. Open a holder-gated Chog game without a Chog and you get a guest mode, a practice mode, a "simulated judge" column. You watch. Someone else plays.


The obvious fix is to let holders lend. But Chog Genesis has no rental role, so lending means sending the NFT to an escrow, wrapping it, or signing setApprovalForAll, which hands a contract the power to move every NFT in the wallet. That power is where NFTs go missing. reNFT renters could hijack rented tokens during the handoff (Code4rena 2024, issue #588). In one 2026 sweep, a single forgotten approval let one wallet take 25,994 NFTs from 3,033 wallets. Holders are right to say no.


So we asked a narrower question. Can someone without a Chog really control one for a while, without the holder giving up anything at all?


WHAT DYBBO DOES

Pick any Chog, pay its price per minute (0.01 MON by default) for 1 to 10 minutes, and you act as it. The whole fee drops into that Chog's escrow. The NFT never moves. A possession is only a record inside the Dybbo contract: who, which Chog, until when, and who owned it when the lease began.

While the timer runs, you haunt. Leave Boo, Slime or Hex on another Chog and the mark sits beside its art on its public page for a day, signed "by #1462, possessed". One haunt every 15 seconds, one per target per day, eight live marks per Chog. The Chog's metadata and image never change.

Holders don't need a lease to haunt with their own Chogs, so a haunted holder can strike back. Holders never sign up either: every Chog in a wallet is open from the first block and earns by default. Whoever holds the Chog when they claim takes its escrow. They can set their own price or close their Chog.


HOW IT HOLDS

The contract touches Chog Genesis in exactly one way: it reads ownerOf. There is no code path to approve or transfer, and a test scans the deployed bytecode for any approve or transfer selector and finds none.

Each haunt re-reads ownerOf inside the same transaction. A lease is live only while the clock hasn't run out and the Chog still belongs to whoever owned it when the lease began. Control ends in the block the lease expires (LeaseExpired) or the block the Chog changes hands (OwnerChanged). No server checks anything later, and nothing needs revoking.

Escrow is keyed to the token, not to a person, and pays only the current ownerOf. Sell your Chog and the buyer can claim what it earned before the sale. The token page says so before anyone buys.

Two edge cases shaped the rules. Chogs held by contracts start closed, because a lending vault could let someone borrow a Chog for one block just to drain its escrow, the trick that once claimed 60,564 APE with five borrowed apes. Smart-account (EIP-7702) wallets count as normal wallets, which keeps 1,968 of the 1,969 Chogs open on day one. And there is no admin: no owner, no pause, no upgrade, no protocol fee, no function that can touch escrowed MON.


DON'T TRUST US, RUN IT

During a possession, press "Try to take it". The app asks the real Chog Genesis contract to move the Chog to you, and it refuses: ERC721InsufficientApproval. Beside the refusal sit the approval reads: approved for all is false, the approved address is empty. Wait out the timer and "Try one more haunt" reverts with LeaseExpired. The /proof page runs all three checks as free simulations against mainnet.


WHAT'S NEW

Every way to lend an NFT today gives a contract power to move it. Dybbo lends control without handing over any power. The possessor gets a role inside Dybbo, enforced by Dybbo, and the Chog never leaves its holder's wallet. Ownership is checked on chain at every action, not by a server on a timer. The collection is open by default, so nobody has to list anything. Fees belong to the token and follow it through sales.

It needs Monad to work. Every haunt is its own transaction with ownerOf read inside it, and with 300 ms blocks and sub-cent fees, a sale or an expiry takes effect on the very next block. On a slower, pricier chain, the practical design is a server that re-checks ownership now and then, which is the exact weakness Dybbo exists to avoid.


A THIRD WAY TO HOLD AN NFT

You can own an NFT or look at one. Dybbo adds a third option: be one, briefly. A mark signed "by #1462, possessed" is a public act by a Chog someone else owns, paid for in advance, with the holder's consent built in by default. A Chog earns while it sits in a wallet, with no listing. And because a live lease is public on chain (leaseOf), any holder-gated Chog game could let a possessor play "as this Chog" instead of benching them in spectator mode.


WHY IT HAS TO BE CHOG

Pull the NFT out and nothing is left. The Chog is the body being possessed. It is the payee, since escrow is keyed to its token ID and only its current owner can claim. It is the off switch, since the lease dies the moment ownerOf changes. And Chog's own lore is a curious, mischievous kid who causes chaos. Dybbo hands that role to anyone for a few minutes.


WHY PEOPLE COME BACK

Getting haunted is a reason to return. The mark names the Chog that left it, and answering costs only gas. Marks expire after 24 hours, so staying haunted, or having the last word, means coming back. Fees keep piling up for holders until they claim. Leases are short enough to do again with another Chog, and a possessor can run several at once. During Chogtober, one possession night leaves the collection visibly haunted the next day.

We won't call retention proven. The contract went live on 2026-10-22, and its counters (possessions, haunts, distinct possessors, fees paid and claimed) are public through stats(). That is how we'll know.


TRY IT

No Chog needed. https://dybbo.vercel.app/judges walks through the full loop with about 0.1 MON.

2. Haunts spread through the collection. Every haunt lands on someone else's Chog, and that holder can answer. Marks last 24 hours, so a busy night leaves the collection visibly haunted the next day and gives people a reason to return.

WHERE WE ARE

WHAT WE MEASURE

Distinct possessors, possessions per possessor (do people come back), haunts per lease, strike-backs (holders answering a haunt), share of fees claimed by holders, and distinct Chogs ever possessed. All of it is on chain, so anyone can check our numbers.

NEXT

- A strike-back shortcut in the activity feed.

Dybbo takes no fee. Every MON goes to holders, which is the point: holders earn by default, so nobody has a reason to opt out. The deployed contract has no owner, no pause and no upgrade, so its rules cannot change under anyone. projects.title: CHOG-TWAIN
projects.description:
CHOG TWAIN: TWO CHOGS, ONE SHARED WALK
Every Chog is looking at someone. Chog Twain turns that glance into a daily promise between two real people. Live on Monad mainnet, no Chog needed to try it.

Film (2:50): https://youtu.be/B1Mk1YjT0Sw
Live app: https://chog-twain.vercel.app   
Demo, no wallet: https://chog-twain.vercel.app/demo

1. THE IDEA
Two friends each pick a Chog. The two Chogs must look at each other. On every UTC day both friends tap "I'm here", the Chogs take one step closer. A day one of them misses, the Chogs drift one step apart. When the gap reaches zero they meet, and the meeting is written onto both Chogs forever. A meeting cannot be bought or rushed: it takes at least N real days on which both people showed up.

2. THE STORY
Lena is a night-shift pharmacist in Leipzig. Her best friend Arjun moved back to Pune, and the messages slowly got shorter. They open a walk. The day closes at 00:00 UTC, which is 02:00 in Leipzig and 05:30 in Pune. On day four Arjun forgets, the Chogs drift apart and a slice of his pledge moves to Lena, who showed up. That night he sends her a voice note. On the last day they meet. (Lena and Arjun are an illustrative story, not real users.)

3. THE DISCOVERY THAT BECAME THE RULE
Every Chog already points left, right, or straight out of the frame, and almost nobody used it. We rebuilt the numbers ourselves from the chain and IPFS (all 1,969 tokenURIs through Multicall3, every metadata file hashed): 650 look left, 1,309 look right, 10 look straight at you. Two Chogs can only meet if they face each other, so at most 660 walks can run at once and 649 right-facing Chogs are always waiting for a partner. Scarcity comes from the art itself.
The gaze lives in IPFS metadata, not on-chain, so the contract checks a Merkle proof against a root fixed at deploy. Anyone can rebuild that root.

4. HOW A WALK WORKS
1) Pick. Any of the 1,969 Chogs, owned or not. Filter by gaze, aura or head.
2) Walk. Send the link or QR code. Your friend joins with a Chog that faces yours. Distance is 7, 14 or 30 steps.
3) Show up. Each person taps "I'm here" once per UTC day with an optional 28-byte note. When the second person arrives, the step is taken in the same transaction.
4) Drift. A missed day moves the Chogs one step apart and a slice of the absent person's optional pledge goes to the one who came. Three unkept days in a row end the walk.
5) Meet. In one transaction: both Friend Books are written, two soulbound postcards are minted, pledges are settled, both Chogs are free to walk again.
Anyone, even with no Chog and no walk, can light a lantern (burns $CHOG, keeps a day only one of the two made, never a day nobody came) or cheer for free.

5. WHAT A MEETING LEAVES
- Friend Books: each Chog keeps an on-chain list of every walk it finished, with whom and how long it took. It follows the token if it is sold, and any app can read it.
- Postcards: one per person, drawn as SVG inside tokenURI, soulbound (ERC-5192), cannot be sold.
- A shareable meeting card, and the pledge back minus a slice per missed day.

6. WHY THE CHOG IS ESSENTIAL
Take the Chog out and nothing works. No gaze: nobody can face anybody and the scarcity disappears. No art: no characters, no meeting scene. No token id: no Friend Book, a meeting belongs to nothing that lasts. No one-walk-per-Chog lock: every Chog is infinite. Holders get an optional keeper's seal and a home-only switch, read live from ownerOf. The contract never writes to the Chog contract; its only call is ownerOf, and CI enforces it.

7. $CHOG (BONUS LAYER, BOTH LIVE)
- Pledges are a commitment contract between two people: equal amounts, escrowed, settled on meeting or ending, claimed by pull.
- Lanterns burn 50 $CHOG to the dead address, so they reduce supply. Price fixed forever.
- Totals are on the Heartbeat page, read straight from contract storage.

8. BUILT FOR MONAD
- Every write shows two stamps: "Landed in block N (proposed)", then "Postmarked. Final in X s". Measured on mainnet: median 1,171 ms to proposed, 2,013 ms to final.
- Monad charges gas by limit, so we measured tight limits on mainnet and send the larger of that and 1.25x the live estimate.
- Logs are limited to 100 blocks per call, so no page scans logs. State sits in packed storage and is read through Multicall3.
- Not claimed: EIP-7702, P256, staking. Only what we use is listed.

9. EXECUTION AND PROOF
- One immutable contract plus a postcard contract on Monad mainnet (chain 143). No owner, no admin, no pause, no upgrade. Both verified on Sourcify.
- 15 invariants each tied to a named test, 42 Foundry tests with a 512-run fuzz, 33 tests on a TypeScript twin of the rules, 146 Playwright tests across 9 viewports with accessibility checks.
- The fuzzer found that missed days reopen the gap, so a meeting takes at least N steps, not exactly N. The rule is stated that way.
- 6 deliberately reverted guard transactions on mainnet prove the checks work.
- The Proof page and "node scripts/verify.mjs" rebuild the gaze root, replay every walk and decode every postcard. PASS or FAIL.
- Lighthouse on the live site: accessibility 100, best practices 100, SEO 100.

10. REAL USAGE, STATED PLAINLY
3 walks opened on mainnet, 2 steps taken, 70 $CHOG pledged, 1 lantern lit, 0 meetings yet (a real meeting needs 7 real days, so the first can land from 28 Oct UTC). Walks 1 and 2 are the builder's own test wallets. Walk 3 was opened and joined by two outside testers; both came back on day 2. Their feedback is in the repo.

11. HOW IT MAPS TO THE CRITERIA
Novelty: gaze as the rule of a shared world, Friend Books on the tokens, a meeting that cannot be bought. Fun: the magazine spread, footprints, postmark thump, notes, lanterns, a scroll story. Retention: a friend who waits, a countdown to 00:00 UTC, calendar reminder, pledges, strangers' lanterns, the next walk. Clarity: one sentence per rule, the Demo in two minutes, every contract error shown as a sentence before the wallet opens. Execution: see 9. $CHOG: see 7.

12. TRY IT
- No wallet: /demo, then "Break a rule".
- Any wallet with a little MON: /walk/new on Monad mainnet.
- Check the claims: /proof and /judge.
Repo: https://github.com/0xkinno/chog-twain

13. WHAT IS NEXT
A read API for Friend Books, push reminders, group walks of four, seasonal walks.

projects.title: Chogsticks
projects.description:
Your Chog gets paid when the internet uses it.

Chogsticks turns every Chog Genesis NFT into an animated sticker pack made from its own on-chain art. Anyone can send it in Discord with /chog, in any server, DM or group chat. Each send is credited to that token, and every week the wallet holding the Chog claims its share of a $CHOG pool on Monad.

THE PROBLEM
PFP art gets passed around chats all day as memes and reaction images. Pudgy Penguins GIFs have tens of billions of GIPHY views, and the people holding those NFTs earn nothing from any of it. Today an NFT only pays its holder when it sells. Chogsticks turns everyday use into income, and that income stays attached to the token.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Send. Type /chog sticker:lfg id:21 in any chat and Chog #21's animated LFG sticker posts. Leave the id empty for a random Chog. The sticker footer says whether the send was credited, and if not, why.
2. Count. The send is credited to token #21. Different people count fully, repeats from one person fade, and fresh alt accounts earn nothing.
3. Settle. Each week the scores become a Merkle root posted to the pool contract on Monad. The full allocation, with every token, score, amount and proof, is published in the repo so anyone can recompute it.
4. Claim. Whoever holds the Chog at claim time collects its $CHOG from the token page or from My Chogs. Sell the Chog and its unclaimed and future earnings go to the buyer.

THE STICKER PACKS
Every one of the 1,969 Chogs gets 6 base stickers (GM, WAGMI, NGMI, COPE, LFG, CHOG ON), each with its own motion: spin, bounce, slam, wobble, punch and strobe. Each Chog also gets up to 3 more stickers picked from its traits. Laser eyes get LASER EYES, a crown gets KING, rainbow puke gets SICK, a green candle gets PUMP IT, a gold tooth gets RICH, and so on across 15 trait stickers. The art is never edited. Every sticker is the token's own image with motion and a caption on top, rendered as a 12-frame animated GIF from the token's on-chain tokenURI.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ON THE SITE
- Try: pick any Chog from 1 to 1969 and flip through its pack. Copy the command, copy the GIF link or download it. No Discord needed.
- Token pages: every Chog has a page with its sends this week, the number of people sending it, its rank, the wallet currently earning from it, an estimate of this week's payout, a 7-day chart, its full pack and its traits.
- Leaderboard: the most memed Chogs this week and all time, with estimated $CHOG for each.
- My Chogs: paste a wallet or connect one and see every Chog it holds, what each one earned, and one Claim all button that pays every posted week for every Chog in a single transaction.
- Pool: the live pool balance, every weekly payout and its status, who controls what, and the on-chain activity.

SCORING AND FAIRNESS
- The 1st send from one person to one Chog in a day scores 1, then 0.5, 0.25, 0.125 and 0.0625. After 5 sends that person's sends to that Chog score 0 until the next day.
- Every new sender starts at full weight, so a Chog earns most when many different people use it.
- Discord accounts younger than 30 days are counted but not credited. The age is read from the Discord user id.
- A replayed Discord interaction is counted once.
- Every request to the bot is checked with Discord's Ed25519 signature before anything is read.
- A Chog's weekly share is its score divided by the total score of all Chogs that week. Each week pays out half of the pool's unallocated balance, so the pool never empties in one week.

WHY THE NFT HAS TO BE THERE
- The pack is the token. Stickers come from that token's image and traits, so 1,969 tokens give 1,969 different packs.
- The payee is the token. Sends are credited to a token id, and the contract pays ownerOf(tokenId) at claim time.
- The income moves with the token. Transfer the Chog and the next claim goes to the new holder.
Take the NFT out and nothing works.

$CHOG AND THE POOL
The pool is funded with $CHOG bought on nad.fun and sent to the ChogsticksPool contract on Monad mainnet. The contract:
- lets anyone add $CHOG with fund()
- lets the poster post one Merkle root per week, never more than the pool holds
- pays only the current ownerOf(tokenId), checks the proof, and blocks double claims
- supports claimMany for claiming several weeks or tokens at once
- has no withdraw function, so nobody can pull the funds back out
It is covered by 16 Foundry tests, including a fuzz test, and its source is verified on Sourcify with an exact match.

ON-CHAIN (Monad mainnet, chain 143)
ChogsticksPool: 0x430dAd64ADF435D9aD6AbCc42340483ec4ad3d04
Chog Genesis: 0xc96d31F8626c6D03Fae5dCD3d61e3FB9F4a73763
$CHOG: 0x350035555E10d9AfAF1566AaebfCeD5BA6C27777

HOW IT IS BUILT
Next.js 16 on Vercel serves the site and the Discord interactions endpoint. Upstash Redis stores sends and scores. sharp renders the stickers from each token's art. viem reads Monad for ownerOf, balances and posted roots. A weekly script builds the Merkle tree with OpenZeppelin's library, publishes the allocation file and posts the root. GitHub Actions runs the scoring tests, type check, lint, build and contract tests on every push.

HONEST LIMITS
- The contract is unaudited.
- Sends are scored off-chain and settled weekly. The poster wallet decides each week's root, but it can't withdraw funds or post more than the pool holds, and every allocation is public.
- Holders can still send their own Chog, capped like anyone else. Wallet linking to block it fully is next.
- Discord only for now. Telegram and X are next.

ChogSweeper lets two collectors swap NFTs directly on Monad. One offer can hold several ERC-721 tokens and some MON on each side. The person making the offer deposits their side into an escrow contract and names what they want back. When the other side accepts, the contract hands over both sides in a single transaction, so nobody can end up holding only half of the trade. If nobody accepts, the maker can cancel and get the NFTs, the MON and the platform fee back.

An offer can be addressed to one wallet or left open so that anyone can accept it. Only collections on a verified list can be traded, which keeps unknown token contracts out of the escrow. The platform fee is small, paid by the maker, and refunded when an offer is cancelled or declined. Holders of the Chog collection pay no fee, and a partner collection can get a discount.

The repository has the Solidity escrow contract with tests, a Next.js app, and an indexer that stores trades in Postgres so history and activity can be shown. There is a Test Faucet page so anyone can mint practice NFTs and try a full swap on Monad Testnet without writing a single command.

This is a testnet prototype. The contracts are not audited, and the Chog collection used in this version is a mock, not the official one.

projects.title: Grand Theft Chog
projects.description:
Grand Theft Chog is a live city at night where every Chog Genesis holder walks the streets as their own Chog, at the same time. Your Chog's traits decide which gang it can rep (20 gangs, each with its own building, vault, walk and lock), and gangs rob each other's vaults.



 robbery has three stages:

1. Break in. Every gang's door has its own lock: pick the pins, cut the alarm wires in order, stop the slot reels on the gang's building, or turn the safe dial. Slip more than once and the alarm goes off.
2. The vault. Grab the cash and crack the safe while the gang's guards hunt you. The guards are that gang's own Chogs. Your Chog's traits are its powers: laser eyes, the cardboard box, a blink, a coin toss to distract the guards and more.
3. The run home. Out of the vault with the bag, you have to carry it through the live city to your own gang's door, with police on foot and siren cars after you, while everyone online watches. Members of the gang you robbed can run you down themselves.


Get home and the cash lands in your gang's vault. Get caught and it goes back, your gang pays a fine, and your Chog sits in the city jail, where a gang-mate can break you out.



What makes it new:

projects.gtm_plan:
Who uses it: Chog NFT holders who want liquidity without selling — people who believe the NFT is worth holding long-term but need short-term capital. The gamble-to-repay mechanic also pulls in a more risk-tolerant crowd who'd never touch a boring lending platform but will take a coin flip on debt forgiveness. On the other side, yield-seeking depositors use the Liquidity Pool as a yield product, earning a share of interest and the house edge without ever touching an NFT themselves.

How it grows:
1. Start inside the Chog community specifically — prove the loop (mint/borrow/gamble/repay) with real Chog holders before generalizing.
2. Expand collateral support to other Monad NFT collections once valuation and liquidation flows are battle-tested, turning Chog Bank from a single-collection app into a general NFT-lending primitive on Monad.
3. Turn on real CHOG buybacks once there's a live DEX pair, replacing the current treasury-backed redemption floor with actual market buy-pressure — a stronger, more visible incentive to hold and use the token.
4. The gamble mechanic is the retention engine: unlike a one-time loan product, it gives people a reason to come back and engage repeatedly, not just borrow once and leave.
5. Pool growth is self-reinforcing — more loan volume means more interest and gamble revenue for LPs, which attracts more deposits, which funds more loans.

projects.title: ChogChoir
projects.description:
Open https://chog-choir.vercel.app. You can listen to everything without logging in. A wallet is only needed to sing in The Choir (steps 3 and 5): press "Connect wallet" at the top right and use any browser wallet, or sign in with email or Google and one is created for you. The Choir comes in two versions: a free one on Monad testnet (step 3, it opens first, no Chog needed) and the real one on Monad mainnet (step 5, a real Chog is needed).

1. SONGS
Type a Chog number (try 1462) and press Play. Try "Duet with Chog #" with 88 and press Sing together. Press "Hum a tune", allow the microphone, wait for the count-in, then hum "ooo" or "la" with a few different notes for about five seconds: the Chog sings your tune back. Save clip, Save poster and Copy link show the exports. If you connect a wallet here, it shows the Chogs you own.

2. STUDIO
Pick a Chog, tap the staff to place its note, change the beat and key, press Play, and copy the link.

3. THE CHOIR, FREE VERSION (Monad testnet, chain 10143)
This is what The Choir opens on, so you can try everything without owning a Chog.
a. Get free testnet MON for gas from https://faucet.monad.xyz or the Alchemy Monad testnet faucet (no sign-up needed).
b. Press "Connect wallet". Use any browser wallet, or choose "Email or Google": a wallet is created for you, and Privy asks you to confirm each transaction. A new wallet starts with no MON, so press "Copy my address" and send that address the testnet MON from the faucet.
c. Press "Claim a free Chog" (a free copy of the real collection). Pick it, tap a cell on the staff, and press Sing. Your Chog lights up in the loft and the voice count goes up.
d. Claim two or three Chogs and press "Sing with all": they all sing in one transaction.
e. Press "Get 1,000 test $CHOG", tap a cell, and press the encore button. It burns 1,000 test $CHOG, adds a second voice, and the "$CHOG burned" counter goes up.
f. Drag "What if more Chogs sing?" to hear the band fill out. It is a preview and is never sent to the chain.
Rounds last 30 minutes on testnet.

4. RECORDS
When a round ends anyone can press "Seal it". Sealed rounds play back, and "Play all" plays every sealed round in order.

5. THE REAL VERSION (Monad mainnet, chain 143)
Press "Real Chogs on Monad" at the top of The Choir, or open https://chog-choir.vercel.app/?net=main#choir. This is the live version. The Choir contract is 0x1C7CF660BD5e858360E261caB59F3CD1638F8bc0 (https://monadvision.com/address/0x1C7CF660BD5e858360E261caB59F3CD1638F8bc0), and for every note it checks ownerOf on the real Chog Genesis (0xc96d31F8626c6D03Fae5dCD3d61e3FB9F4a73763). Singing here needs a real Chog in your connected wallet and a little MON for gas (a note costs about 0.02 MON). An encore burns 1,000 real $CHOG (0x350035555E10d9AfAF1566AaebfCeD5BA6C27777). Rounds are one day long and turn over at 00:00 UTC.
This choir starts empty and fills only as real Chog holders sing, so you may see an empty loft ("Nobody has sung this round. Be the first."). If you do not hold a Chog you can still connect a wallet (the page says it holds no Chog Genesis and offers the free version) and drag "What if more Chogs sing?" to hear what the round becomes. To sing without owning a Chog, use the free version in step 3.

The code is at https://github.com/JemIIahh/chog-choir . Its README lists every contract address and how each part was tested.

projects.gtm_plan:
WHO FIRST
Chog holders, because the Choir needs them, and the wider Monad community, who can try the free testnet version without owning a Chog.

WHY THEY COME BACK
Rounds repeat every day. Streaks track who shows up every round. The band only reaches full strength when enough different Chogs have sung (a pad at 5, bass at 25, drums at 100), and the loft makes the collective visible: you can see your Chog among the others. Encores give $CHOG a use that takes tokens out of supply, and the page shows the running total burned.

HOW IT SPREADS
Every Chog already has a clip, a poster in its own colours, and a link that opens straight to its song, all made in one tap. Holders post their Chog's song. A duet link pairs any two Chogs, so people can tag a friend's Chog, and a hummed tune is a personal clip nobody else can make.

LAUNCH STEPS
1. Post the clip of one Chog with a link that plays it, in the Chog Discord and on X.
2. Post the loft each day from the daily mainnet round: how many Chogs sang, which band layer unlocked.
3. Ask each holder to bring one other holder, to reach the next layer (25 singers for bass, 100 for drums).
4. Collect feedback from the first holders and publish a changelog.

WHAT IT COSTS
Nothing beyond gas. There is no backend of our own to host, and the front end is a static site.

WHAT WE WILL WATCH
How many Chogs have sung, voices per round, streak length and how much $CHOG has been burned. All of it can be read straight from the contract.

projects.title: Etalabs
projects.description:
ETA is a multichain peer-to-peer NFT trading protocol inspired by Steam trading and swapping Pokémon cards. Imagine I want your Chog and you want my NFTs. Instead of listing them on marketplaces and waiting for buyers, we can negotiate a direct exchange, build a bundle, and share a trade link.

Trading itself can be fun: finding your favourite Chog, comparing collections, negotiating an offer, or swapping with friends. That’s what we feel is missing in NFTs right now. Everything revolves around floor prices, volume, buying, and selling. We want to bring back the fun of collecting.

Collectors choose the NFTs on both sides and can add the network’s native token or supported $CHOG to balance the exchange. The recipient can review, accept, change the offer, or decline. Collection verification information and OpenSea links help users inspect the NFTs, while Activity helps them find their offers again.

ETA supports two trade modes. In-wallet keeps NFTs with the owner until acceptance. Where a collection restricts the required direct transfer, Escrow provides a deposit-based flow. Creators can cancel offers, with separate withdrawal or claim steps where required.

For Chogathon, Chog has two roles: $CHOG can be included alongside NFTs in trade offers, and we plan to give Chog NFT holders free protocol use beyond the fee-free beta. Network gas remains separate. This connects the token, collectibles, and community through practical trading utility.

Our demo runs on Monad and shows an NFT offer containing native tokens and $CHOG, offer sharing, cancellation and withdrawal, collection checks through OpenSea, and a separate completed NFT swap between two wallets we control.

ETA began before Chogathon. This submission builds on that foundation with Chog token support and a focus on the Chog community. As collections and preferences change, there’s another Chog to discover, another bundle to negotiate, and another reason to trade.

Follow ETA Labs: https://x.com/etalabshq

projects.title: Chog Legacy
projects.description:
What happens when a Chog changes hands, but its past stays with it?

Chog Legacy is a choice-driven storytelling game where each Chog Genesis NFT carries a continuing history. Players make daily decisions that shape trust, notoriety, supplies, and unfinished promises. The next owner inherits the character those decisions created.

A small act of generosity can open a story that returns in a later chapter. An unresolved obligation can outlive the wallet that began it. New owners can embrace or redeem their inherited reputation as they continue the journal.

The Chog NFT is essential to real gameplay: the connected wallet must own the selected token, with ownership checked on Monad mainnet. Progress belongs to that NFT’s identity rather than the player’s wallet. Gameplay and history are stored in the application database; ownership is read from the blockchain.

Built features include:
• Three daily choices per Chog, with exact outcome previews.
• A persistent chronicle of decisions and consequences.
• Connected story chapters and unfinished obligations.
• Ownership handoff with inherited stats, history, and remaining daily actions.
• Public NFT profiles and wallet sign-in.
• A mobile-friendly storybook interface.
• Wallet-free practice with a clearly labeled simulated handoff.

Anyone can explore practice mode; Chog holders can continue their own token’s story.

projects.title: CHOG : ROOM ZERO
projects.description:
CHOG: ROOM ZERO is a tactical multiplayer shooter built around one idea: information is a resource.

Players move through dark, tense environments where hearing an enemy, choosing when to peek, reading movement, and deciding when to engage can matter more than simply having better aim.

The game supports solo play, 1v1 duels, 3v3 fights, and 5v5 holder gameplay. Players can creep around corners, track enemies through sound, fight, reload, use abilities, and make decisions with incomplete information.

But the biggest differentiator is CHOG integration.

CHOG isn't just a collectible sitting beside the game. Its traits are integrated directly into gameplay. Traits such as Laser Eyes, Visor, Bubblegum, Drooling and Aura map to actual abilities, with rarity affecting properties such as range, duration and cooldown. Every ability is designed around readable telegraphs and counters, making the CHOG itself part of how you play.

The result is a multiplayer game where your CHOG can actually change the way you approach a fight.

We built ROOM ZERO to make information, positioning and identity matter.

projects.title: Chug world
projects.description:
CHOG World gives every Chog Genesis NFT its own ERC-6551 wallet and an AI agent that decides what it does: quests, arena fights, shopping or rest. Every move is checked onchain against limits the owner signed, and everything the Chog earns lives in its own wallet, so it moves with the NFT when it is sold.

Every Chog has a look. CHOG World gives it a life.

THE PROBLEM
A Chog Genesis NFT is a picture. Once it is in your wallet it does nothing: no history, no growth, no reason to come back. And "AI agents for NFTs" usually means a server holding your keys, which no holder should accept.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Awaken (one short wizard). The Chog gets a Tokenbound V3 account from the canonical ERC-6551 registry, created free. The owner grants permission to ChogOperator, our rules contract, never to a server key. They name it, give it a personality, pick goals (money, reputation, exploring, strength) and a daily budget, and fund it with $CHOG for fees and a little MON for gas.
2. It lives on its own. A few times a day the backend builds the Chog's menu of legal, affordable moves, and an LLM (Gemini, falling back to OpenRouter, then a rule-based picker) chooses one and writes a thought in the Chog's voice, shaped by its personality. Arena odds come from simulating the real battle engine.
3. The chain decides. ChogOperator checks every move against the owner's policy: per-move cap, rolling 24-hour budget, moves per day, allowed actions, expiry, pause, and a gas limit the owner signed. The keeper can only call typed game actions; it can never move funds anywhere else.
4. Fair outcomes. Quests and fights resolve from a block hash two blocks after the move, which nobody can know when the move is made. The battle engine exists in Solidity and TypeScript; every replay on the Arena page is re-run in the browser and checked against the onchain log hash.
5. It becomes someone. XP, levels, titles (First Blood, Giant Slayer, Unbroken, Explorer), scars, gear and rivalries. Its portrait is its own Genesis artwork with an evolving frame, level badge, gear and title ribbon, and every Chog gets a share card for X.
6. It moves with the NFT. Sell the Chog and the agent stops instantly; its $CHOG, gear and trophies go to the buyer inside its own wallet.

WHAT THE OWNER STILL CONTROLS
Goals and budget presets, pause and revoke, a daily check-in streak (XP boost, Devoted trophy), a "While you were away" recap written by the AI from the journal, a gas tank, and a Grudge: name a rival and, while the odds are fair, it is the only Chog yours will challenge.

ARENA
Chogs challenge Chogs owned by other wallets, staking 10, 50 or 200 $CHOG. The winner gets the stake back plus a 70% Treasury bonus; a defender who holds keeps half the stake as a bounty, so Chogs earn while their owners sleep. Pair cooldowns, a defender hourly cap and a different-owner rule stop farming.

$CHOG
$CHOG is the whole economy: quest fees, arena stakes, gear and rewards. 10% of every fee and stake is burned. The Treasury is refilled with 90% of every fee, shop purchases and lost stakes, pays out at most 150 $CHOG a day, and never more than it holds, so it cannot be drained. Quest rewards are tuned so the Treasury mostly recycles player fees.

SUSTAINABLE BY DESIGN
Monad charges the gas limit, so every move costs the keeper real MON. Each Chog repays it: a fixed per-move gas fee in MON from its own wallet, capped by the owner's signed limit and a hard 0.5 MON ceiling, pulled by the keeper rather than pushed so a recipient can never break a move. Moves are spread across the day (6 on the Balanced preset). Running the world does not get more expensive as players join.

WHAT IS LIVE RIGHT NOW
- Mainnet pilot on Chog Genesis and real $CHOG, open to the first 25 Chogs: https://chog-world-mainnet.vercel.app
  ChogOperator 0xaDaA7f21Fb843140E20115D84F51F6f85D5342D1, Treasury 0x1814943bc12E643D1477b47F0B3cD495Fe07fce6 (seeded with 390 $CHOG), ChogState 0x33B273B62d3e364dc1Ec33aC2800AAeAb1067618.
- Free testnet with test Chogs and test $CHOG: https://chog-world-zeta.vercel.app
  7 Chogs have played, 14 arena battles have been fought (13 settled onchain), and the agents write their own thoughts.
- 94 Foundry tests (including invariants), plus a fork test against Monad mainnet with a real Chog Genesis NFT and the real Tokenbound V3 account; 51 backend tests, including an end-to-end loop on a forked chain with gas fees.

HONEST SCOPE
No Chog Genesis holder has played on mainnet yet; the mainnet flow is proven by the fork test and a simulated awakening, and the demo video is recorded on testnet. The contracts are tested but not audited.

WHY THE NFT IS ESSENTIAL
Take the NFT away and nothing works: the Chog's wallet is derived from the NFT, the agent's authority is bound to the NFT's owner, and the character, its wallet and everything in it transfer with the NFT.

WHAT'S NEXT (ROADMAP)
Grow the pilot past 25 Chogs; weekly seasons with Treasury prizes; Genesis traits as gameplay (what a Chog wears gives it bonuses).

projects.description:
# Chogsweeper

Pick a Chog. Today it's a minesweeper board, and it plays differently from every other Chog's board.

Chogsweeper is a daily minesweeper game for the Chog Genesis NFT collection on Monad. Each of the 1,969 Chogs gets its own board every day. Its traits change the rules, and when you clear the board, the picture underneath is that Chog's art.

- Live: https://chogsweeper.vercel.app
- Demo video: https://youtu.be/O-yxoGDZl9g
- Code: https://github.com/Sireadell/chogsweeper

## Try it in one minute, no wallet

1. Open https://chogsweeper.vercel.app/judge and type 7.
2. Read the rule cards to see what this Chog's traits do.
3. Tap a tile to open it. Right-click to flag, or use Flag mode on a phone.
4. Clear the board and the Chog's full art appears.

## How a Chog becomes the board

The token number and today's date set the mines, so a Chog's board is the same for everyone that day. Then four traits change the rules. Tier sets the size, from Common at 8 by 8 with 10 mines up to Legendary at 14 by 14 with 30. Eyes give a free safe peek (939 of 1,969 Chogs). A solid hat, cap or helmet takes one hit for you (1,147). Any accessory flags one real mine for you (195).

## Fair boards you can check

Just after midnight UTC the site posts a fingerprint of the day's secret on Monad. A fingerprint is a short code that matches one secret and no other. When the day ends the secret is published, and anyone can open /verify, pick a past day and any Chog, and watch the page rebuild that board and check it against the fingerprint. A daily timer has posted it on its own since October 21. First automatic post: https://monadvision.com/tx/0x559d502b936385c1dde5028e0bf9a70617b93180402ea3d5d8dba4e96ee10def

What this proves: the boards were fixed before anyone played and weren't changed afterwards. It doesn't hide today's boards from my own server while the day is live, and /verify says that too.

**Why you'd come back tomorrow**

- Chog of the day: one shared board, and anyone holding a Chog gets one ranked try. Fastest clear wins, top 10 at /hall.
- Streaks that belong to the Chog itself.
- The reveal wall at /wall, filling in with art as Chogs get cleared.
- Share cards with your Chog's art, your time and that day's fingerprint.

Hold 1,000 $CHOG or more and you get one safe-tile hint per board, marked "hinted" so rankings stay fair. Nothing is spent.

**The Daily Pot (built, not open yet).** I built an optional $CHOG pot where the day's three fastest clears split what people put in, and its contract is live on Monad at 0xE330Ff89faC8685b1a2b564407A6b5A2EbDA4c2A. The pot page is off today, so no one can enter yet, and prize pools can be restricted where you live, so check your local rules.

## Not proven yet

- No holder has played a ranked run yet.
- The reveal wall shows 0 of 1,969 cleared.
- The $CHOG hint hasn't been run with a real holder's wallet.

Built with Monad mainnet, Chog Genesis, $CHOG, Next.js, viem, Upstash Redis and Vercel. The board engine started from my earlier game ghostsweeper (https://github.com/Sireadell/ghostsweeper).

Next: challenge links to race a friend on the same mines, then head-to-head matches. Planned, not built.

projects.title: ChogTown
projects.description:
Chogtown is a live town where all 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs live together. Chogs walk around, gossip, roast each other and hold grudges. 

The town runs on the server all day, so the drama happens even when nobody is online, and every viewer sees the same Chogs doing the same things at the same moment. Holders play their own Chog. Everyone else watches, reads any Chog's story and plays the casino with free chips.

What you can do

Watch. Tap any Chog to read its story: who it loves, who it can't stand and what it did last night. The Grand Gazette reports the town's drama.

Play your own Chog. Sign in with the wallet that holds it and it walks onto the island wearing a crown. Tap anywhere to walk, or tap another Chog to play a card: Roast, Spread a rumour, Flirt, Make up or Challenge. The two Chogs act the scene out in speech bubbles, in character, in front of the whole town.

Watch feuds grow. Every pair of Chogs has a feud level: Cordial, Side-eye, Beef, Public feud, then Main Event. Roasts and rumours heat it up, and flirting and making up cool it down. Rivals who bump into each other heat it up on their own, so drama builds even when nobody is playing.

The Main Event. When a feud goes far enough, or a holder challenges a rival, the bell rings. Every Chog walks to the Royal Amphitheatre and the two Chogs fight in the Rumble, a ring-out brawler where each Chog's moves come from its traits. Everyone watches the same fight live. If nobody books one, a Main Event starts every 6 minutes for the hottest feud.

The Lucky Lilypad. The town casino uses play chips only, which can't be bought or cashed out. Chog Slots uses Chog symbols, with Frog Dad as the jackpot. The Main Event book is a betting pool, so the odds move as people bet.

Also in town: the Face Booth, where your face on webcam fires your Chog's powers; daily quests paid in chips; a Chog of the Day crown; day and night on UTC time; the Palace of Legends leaderboards; and the Boutique.

Why the Chog NFT is essential

Without the NFT, Chogtown has no cast, no players and no story.

The NFT is the character. Every resident is a Chog Genesis token. Its Eyes and Mouth set its personality type (Critic, Hype Chog, Dreamer, Schemer, Sweetheart, Drama Chog, Brawler or Know-It-All), which sets how it talks and who it clashes with. Its Rumble moves come from its traits: Eyes are the attack, Mouth is the special and Head is the dash.

Traits are powers. Laser eyes can Zap. A crown can Claim the Crown. A frog calls Frog Dad to end a feud. Skulls Haunt at night. Candles Pump or Dump a Main Event's odds. Clowns Prank. Legendaries get every power.

Only holders play. The server checks ownerOf on Monad. Holders can also give their Chog a plan for the day (Chase the crown, Pick fights, Make friends or Lay low), and it keeps to the plan while they're away.

The chain moves the story. The server watches Chog Genesis Transfer events on Monad. When a Chog sells, the town reacts live, the Gazette reports it, and its card shows the new holder and how many times it has changed hands.

History belongs to the token. Feuds, records, crowns, tips and diaries are stored per token, so buying a Chog means buying its friends and rivals.

Rarity is fame. Legendaries and Epics stand taller and wear a gold or violet frame, and rarer Chogs are picked for more Main Events.

$CHOG

$CHOG holders get bigger daily chips: +200 a day from 1,000 $CHOG, +500 from 25,000 and +1,500 from 250,000. Anyone can tip a Chog 100, 1,000 or 10,000 $CHOG from its card, and the tip goes straight to whoever holds that Chog. The server confirms the Transfer on Monad before counting it, and the tip appears in the Gazette.

How to try it

1. Open  https://chogtown.nerom.site/  and press Watch live.
2. Tap any Chog to see how its traits shaped it.
3. Open the Casino and spin Chog Slots with your free chips.
4. Wait for the bell (a Main Event starts every 6 minutes), back a side and watch the fight live.
5. To play, sign in with a wallet that holds a Chog, press "Bring it onto the island", then tap another Chog and play a card.

Usage so far (Oct 20 to 22, before any public launch): 18 visitors, 93 page views and 3 holders playing their own Chog. The town has run on its own the whole time: 352 Main Events fought and 1,154 trait powers used by Chogs acting on their own.

Everything was built during the hackathon. The repo starts on Oct 14.

projects.title: ChogTales: The Daily Manga
projects.description:
ChogTales: The Daily Manga turns your Chog NFT into the hero of a manga that is written and drawn fresh every day. How you raise your Chog decides who it becomes.

Every day you read a new chapter (cover, two pages of panels, a teaser) drawn with your Chog as the hero, then make a final decision that shapes the next chapter. You feed it, care for it, or start beef with another player's Chog. There is no visible formula: each action quietly shifts a hidden personality, and the next chapter makes the consequences happen on the page. A thief can become a sheriff, a rebel a mayor. The saga runs in 19 seven-chapter seasons and never resets.

The Chog is essential. The AI artist gets your Chog's NFT image as a reference in every panel, so the hero has your Chog's hat, eyewear and outfit. Its on-chain traits set its hidden personality and plot. Every action checks ownerOf on Monad, so only the holder writes its story, and the saga goes with the NFT if you sell it. Other players' Chogs appear as rivals, and beef lands in their chapter too.

The Manga Library turns this into an economy. Publish any chapter free or for $CHOG. Readers unlock with an on-chain $CHOG transfer straight to the creator, verified on Monad, with no platform cut.

Built from scratch during Chogathon 2026. Live now, works on phones.

projects.gtm_plan:
THE MARKET: MANGA IS A MULTI-BILLION-DOLLAR BUSINESS, AND CHOG HAS NONE OF IT
Manga is one of the largest creator economies in entertainment.
- Japan's manga market alone was 692.5 billion yen (about US$4.4 billion) in 2025, and digital formats were already 72.7% of it in 2024 (512.2 billion yen).
- Global estimates for 2025 run from roughly US$10 billion to US$19 billion depending on the research firm, with forecasts of about double that within a decade.
- Webtoon Entertainment alone reported about US$1.4 billion in revenue for 2025 and about 145 million monthly users, which shows people already pay to read serialized comics on their phones.

Today that money flows from readers to platforms and publishers, and the character IP behind each series belongs to someone else. Chog holders own an NFT collection, but the collection has no content economy attached to it. ChogTales is the missing piece: it makes every Chog a manga character that generates chapters every day, and it gives those chapters a market.

THE LIBRARY IS THE ECONOMY, AND IT IS WHY WE BUILT IT
Every holder is a publisher. Any finished chapter can be put in the public Manga Library, free or priced in $CHOG. A reader who unlocks a chapter sends $CHOG on Monad directly to the holder's wallet. The server verifies the on-chain Transfer before unlocking, each transaction unlocks once, and ChogTales takes no cut. The holder keeps 100% of what readers pay.
- For holders: a Chog stops being only a collectible. It becomes a character that earns, with the holder as author and publisher, at zero production cost because the writing and art are generated.
- For $CHOG: every unlock is a real purchase of the token for a real product. Demand is tied to content people want to read, not to speculation alone.
- For readers: a growing shelf of manga starring Chogs they recognise, with free previews (cover and page 1) before they pay.
- For the Chog collection: ownership gains a daily utility. A Chog with a popular saga is worth more than the same Chog without one, and the saga travels with the NFT, because only the current holder can write its story.

THE FLYWHEEL
1. Holders play daily (feed, care, decide, start beef) and get a new chapter every day, so supply of content is continuous and automatic.
2. Beef and rivalry put one holder's Chog into another's story, so players pull each other in and each chapter has an audience built in.
3. Holders publish their best chapters and earn $CHOG from readers.
4. Earnings make holders want to keep playing and bring in more Chog holders; readers without a Chog find a reason to buy one, or to hold $CHOG.
5. More chapters make the Library more valuable, which brings more readers.

HOW WE REACH THEM
- Chog holders first, through the Chog community, who already own the characters.
- Every chapter is a finished, shareable manga page set (PDF export, link-preview card) starring a recognisable Chog, so every publish is also a marketing post.
- Rivalry notifications: a rival's chapter is a reason to come back.

NEXT STEPS
- Run a closed season with a group of holders and measure what matters: chapters published, chapters unlocked, $CHOG volume, and day-to-day return rate.
- Featured and seasonal shelves, creator pages and ratings so the best sagas surface.
- Collected seasons as printable or downloadable volumes that can also be sold.
- Mobile wallet support through WalletConnect (wired in, needs a project ID) and a polished phone reading mode.
- Keep the core daily chapter free for holders. Story and art run on free tiers today, so before wide launch we will move to paid inference and fund it from optional extras, never by taking a cut of creator sales.

projects.title: ChogChronicle
projects.description:
Every Chog builds a history, and that history changes what happens between Chogs.

Most NFTs forget everything. A Chog looks the same whether it kept its word or betrayed a friend. ChogChronicle is a persistent social world for all 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs on Monad. Each Chog has its own reputation, relationships, rivalries, achievements and a permanent chronicle, all tied to the token, not the wallet. If a Chog changes hands, its story goes with it.

HOW TO PLAY
Pick your Chog: we check ownership on-chain, or you can use demo mode without a wallet. Then interact with any other Chog by befriending, pranking, dueling, or gifting 25 $CHOG. Each Chog's traits shape the result, which is written into both Chogs' chronicles. Repeated interactions turn Chogs into Friends, Sworn Allies, Rivals or a Nemesis. Each Chog gets 3 energy a day, with a streak bonus for coming back.

THE SQUARE AND WITNESSES
A live feed shows every moment and who is online. For 10 minutes after a moment, another holder can Witness it, and it then permanently shows "Witnessed by #N". Witnessed moments count double, so your history is vouched for by other players, not just written by you.

PACTS AND BETRAYAL
Two Chogs that are already friends can seal a Pact. Both owners sign and each stakes $CHOG. How big the Pact can be depends on their shared history: Bronze, Silver or Gold. If either Chog duels or pranks its partner during the Pact, that's a Betrayal: it's written into both chronicles and the betrayed Chog takes the whole pot. If both keep the Pact to the end, they get their stakes back and earn a permanent Sworn badge.

WHY THE NFT IS ESSENTIAL
The Chog is the player. Every reputation score, relationship, Pact and witness is stored against a Chog token ID, and every wallet action is signed and checked against ownerOf on Monad mainnet.

HOW $CHOG IS USED
Gifts are real ERC-20 transfers, and the server checks each transaction receipt on-chain before recording the gift. Pact stakes make keeping or breaking your word matter.

projects.title: Chog League
projects.description:
Chog League turns your Chog into a trading account with a record you can prove.

Pick a market (BTC, ETH, SOL or MON), call HIGHER or LOWER over 1 to 5 minutes, set your stake and a payout multiplier, and watch the live price. Every call settles on real Coinbase prices, at the close of the 1-minute candle when it expires. Trading uses demo money, so a bad call never costs real funds.

What's new: skill you can prove, saved on the NFT

- Fair at every multiplier. The target price is set from each market's recent volatility, so your chance of winning is about 1 in (1 + multiplier). 1x is a coin flip, 5x is 1 in 6. No setting is a better deal than another; only your reads are.

- Level = wins minus losses. Because the odds are fair, luck cancels out over time, so a Chog's level is a skill score. Higher levels unlock bigger multipliers, from 1.5x at Level 1 (Rookie) to 5x at Level 5 (Legend, 50 net wins).

- Everything is saved to the Chog's token ID, never the wallet. Level, record, weekly crowns and cosmetics travel with the NFT. Sell your Chog and the buyer gets a proven trader. That is a new kind of NFT value: a track record.

WHY THE CHOG IS ESSENTIAL

- The Chog IS the account. League play, levels, duels for the league and the crown only exist for a Chog, and only its owner can play it: ownership is re-checked on Monad (ownerOf) before every trade.

- No two Chogs play the same. Each one's traits decide its gameplay: its Background gives it a home market (+1x multiplier there), and its Eyes give it one daily power: Shield (a loss doesn't drop its level), Double Up (a win counts twice) or Parachute (half the risk, half the profit). All of them keep the odds fair, so rare Chogs don't win automatically.

- The Chog reacts on its picture: it bounces with confetti on a win, shakes and greys out on a loss, burns on a hot streak, frosts on a cold one, and wears a crown as the league's number one.

Anyone can try it in Practice mode with any Chog and no wallet. Practice never counts toward records or the league.


THREE WAYS TO PLAY

- Calls: quick higher-or-lower trades, up to 5 open at once. Want out early? Cash out any live call for what it's worth right now (its chance of winning × what it pays, minus a 2% exit fee); a cash-out counts as neither a win nor a loss, so levels stay honest.

- Duels, Chog vs Chog: see who's online and challenge them. Quick duels and best of 3 or 5 use hidden picks with a 20-second window; Arenas run 15 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours with a $1,000 bankroll each. Both sides put in the same demo stake and the winner takes the pot. Practice players can duel a bot.

- Weekly league: every Monday at 00:00 UTC every Chog restarts with $1,000 demo. The highest balance at the reset wins the crown, a real $CHOG prize and a place in the Hall of Champions. Daily streaks and daily power recharges bring players back every day.

Easy to start, fun to watch

- Know what to do from the first second: a 47-second "How to play" clip on the home page, then a step-by-step guide that lights up each control in turn and walks a new player through their first call (market, time, amount, multiplier, power, Higher or Lower).

- A chart you can feel: your Chog's picture rides the live price, glowing green when you're winning and red when you're not. Your win zone is shaded, your entry and target are marked, and a 🏁 finish flag counts down. A strip under the chart says "winning!" or "needs +$12.40 higher". A "LIVE · Prices by Coinbase" badge shows the prices are real.

- Share cards: every finished call makes an image of your Chog with a stamp (WIN or REKT), a funny line ("Got rekt.", "Called it.", "Paper hands, paper money.") and the result, ready to share, save or post on X. The server builds it from the saved trade, so nobody can fake a big win.

- History on every Chog: every call and duel it has played, with hit rate, net result, best win, worst loss and favourite market, filters, and each duel's opponent and score. The league history belongs to the token, so anyone can check a Chog's record, including someone about to buy it.


$CHOG integration

- Shop: titles (250 $CHOG), profile frames (500) and victory animations (1,000). Looks only, never an advantage, and saved to the Chog so they go with it when it's sold. Anyone can try items on for free.

- Payments are checked on-chain: the buyer sends $CHOG from their wallet, and the server reads the Transfer on Monad (sender, receiver, amount) before handing over the item. Each payment counts once.

- Every sale grows the prize: the weekly prize starts at 2,000 $CHOG, plus 70% of that week's shop sales; the other 30% is burned. Payments and burns are linked in the Hall of Champions ("Paid ✓", "burned ✓") so anyone can check them.

- Chip in: anyone can add $CHOG to this week's prize; all of it goes to the winner.

- Tip the champion: $CHOG goes straight from the tipper to the reigning champion's owner.

- Holders: wallets with 10,000+ $CHOG get a 💜 holder badge on their Chogs and 20% off in the shop.

Trading and duels never use real money: $CHOG rewards play and is never gambled.


UNDER THE HOOD

Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind), wagmi + viem with a browser wallet, Monad mainnet (Chog Genesis NFT and the $CHOG token), Supabase for records, and Coinbase's public API for live prices.

Sign-in is a free signed message; no transaction is needed to play. Built solo during Chogathon.

No pre-existing code; and the Chog art and traits come from the collection's own metadata.


FEEDBACK AND USAGE

We shared the live app with builders and Chog NFT holders while building, and shipped their feedback the same day:

- "Once I land, I should know what to do next" → the "How to play" clip on the home page.

- "I barely know what to click next, hold my hand" → the step-by-step guide for a first call.

- "Are the live prices real? Show who provides them" → the "LIVE · Prices by Coinbase" badge.

- "The charts look very basic, gamify the chart" → win zone, finish flag, the Chog riding the price and the winning / needs-$X strip.

- "Let me generate a PnL card with a funny line, like Chog got rekt" → share cards for every call.

- "Why can't I close a position early?" →  Cash out, at a fair price, with a "Take $X now?" check. Two testers asked for it, so it shipped.

- A way to look back at past trades and duels → History on every Chog.


WHAT'S NEXT

- Publish each Chog's record on-chain, so marketplaces and other apps can show a Chog's level and crowns next to its price.

- Seasons: monthly championships across the weekly leagues, with bigger $CHOG prizes.

- More shop items, including duel arena themes, and community-designed cosmetics.

- More markets, and tournaments run with the Chog community.

projects.title: Chog League
projects.description:
Chog League turns your Chog into a trading account with a record you can prove.

Pick a market (BTC, ETH, SOL or MON), call HIGHER or LOWER over 1 to 5 minutes, set your stake and a payout multiplier, and watch the live price. Every call settles on real Coinbase prices, at the close of the 1-minute candle when it expires. Trading uses demo money, so a bad call never costs real funds.

What's new: skill you can prove, saved on the NFT

- Fair at every multiplier. The target price is set from each market's recent volatility, so your chance of winning is about 1 in (1 + multiplier). 1x is a coin flip, 5x is 1 in 6. No setting is a better deal than another; only your reads are.

- Level = wins minus losses. Because the odds are fair, luck cancels out over time, so a Chog's level is a skill score. Higher levels unlock bigger multipliers, from 1.5x at Level 1 (Rookie) to 5x at Level 5 (Legend, 50 net wins).

- Everything is saved to the Chog's token ID, never the wallet. Level, record, weekly crowns and cosmetics travel with the NFT. Sell your Chog and the buyer gets a proven trader. That is a new kind of NFT value: a track record.

WHY THE CHOG IS ESSENTIAL

- The Chog IS the account. League play, levels, duels for the league and the crown only exist for a Chog, and only its owner can play it: ownership is re-checked on Monad (ownerOf) before every trade.

- No two Chogs play the same. Each one's traits decide its gameplay: its Background gives it a home market (+1x multiplier there), and its Eyes give it one daily power: Shield (a loss doesn't drop its level), Double Up (a win counts twice) or Parachute (half the risk, half the profit). All of them keep the odds fair, so rare Chogs don't win automatically.

- The Chog reacts on its picture: it bounces with confetti on a win, shakes and greys out on a loss, burns on a hot streak, frosts on a cold one, and wears a crown as the league's number one.

Anyone can try it in Practice mode with any Chog and no wallet. Practice never counts toward records or the league.


THREE WAYS TO PLAY

- Calls: quick higher-or-lower trades, up to 5 open at once. Want out early? Cash out any live call for what it's worth right now (its chance of winning × what it pays, minus a 2% exit fee); a cash-out counts as neither a win nor a loss, so levels stay honest.

- Duels, Chog vs Chog: see who's online and challenge them. Quick duels and best of 3 or 5 use hidden picks with a 20-second window; Arenas run 15 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours with a $1,000 bankroll each. Both sides put in the same demo stake and the winner takes the pot. Practice players can duel a bot.

- Weekly league: every Monday at 00:00 UTC every Chog restarts with $1,000 demo. The highest balance at the reset wins the crown, a real $CHOG prize and a place in the Hall of Champions. Daily streaks and daily power recharges bring players back every day.

Easy to start, fun to watch

- Know what to do from the first second: a 47-second "How to play" clip on the home page, then a step-by-step guide that lights up each control in turn and walks a new player through their first call (market, time, amount, multiplier, power, Higher or Lower).

- A chart you can feel: your Chog's picture rides the live price, glowing green when you're winning and red when you're not. Your win zone is shaded, your entry and target are marked, and a 🏁 finish flag counts down. A strip under the chart says "winning!" or "needs +$12.40 higher". A "LIVE · Prices by Coinbase" badge shows the prices are real.

- Share cards: every finished call makes an image of your Chog with a stamp (WIN or REKT), a funny line ("Got rekt.", "Called it.", "Paper hands, paper money.") and the result, ready to share, save or post on X. The server builds it from the saved trade, so nobody can fake a big win.

- History on every Chog: every call and duel it has played, with hit rate, net result, best win, worst loss and favourite market, filters, and each duel's opponent and score. The league history belongs to the token, so anyone can check a Chog's record, including someone about to buy it.


$CHOG integration

- Shop: titles (250 $CHOG), profile frames (500) and victory animations (1,000). Looks only, never an advantage, and saved to the Chog so they go with it when it's sold. Anyone can try items on for free.

- Payments are checked on-chain: the buyer sends $CHOG from their wallet, and the server reads the Transfer on Monad (sender, receiver, amount) before handing over the item. Each payment counts once.

- Every sale grows the prize: the weekly prize starts at 2,000 $CHOG, plus 70% of that week's shop sales; the other 30% is burned. Payments and burns are linked in the Hall of Champions ("Paid ✓", "burned ✓") so anyone can check them.

- Chip in: anyone can add $CHOG to this week's prize; all of it goes to the winner.

- Tip the champion: $CHOG goes straight from the tipper to the reigning champion's owner.

- Holders: wallets with 10,000+ $CHOG get a 💜 holder badge on their Chogs and 20% off in the shop.

Trading and duels never use real money: $CHOG rewards play and is never gambled.


UNDER THE HOOD

Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind), wagmi + viem with a browser wallet, Monad mainnet (Chog Genesis NFT and the $CHOG token), Supabase for records, and Coinbase's public API for live prices.

Sign-in is a free signed message; no transaction is needed to play. Built solo during Chogathon.

No pre-existing code; and the Chog art and traits come from the collection's own metadata.


FEEDBACK AND USAGE

We shared the live app with builders and Chog NFT holders while building, and shipped their feedback the same day:

- "Once I land, I should know what to do next" → the "How to play" clip on the home page.

- "I barely know what to click next, hold my hand" → the step-by-step guide for a first call.

- "Are the live prices real? Show who provides them" → the "LIVE · Prices by Coinbase" badge.

- "The charts look very basic, gamify the chart" → win zone, finish flag, the Chog riding the price and the winning / needs-$X strip.

- "Let me generate a PnL card with a funny line, like Chog got rekt" → share cards for every call.

- "Why can't I close a position early?" →  Cash out, at a fair price, with a "Take $X now?" check. Two testers asked for it, so it shipped.

- A way to look back at past trades and duels → History on every Chog.


WHAT'S NEXT

- Publish each Chog's record on-chain, so marketplaces and other apps can show a Chog's level and crowns next to its price.

- Seasons: monthly championships across the weekly leagues, with bigger $CHOG prizes.

- More shop items, including duel arena themes, and community-designed cosmetics.

- More markets, and tournaments run with the Chog community.

projects.description:
Chogmog: make mischief move.

Chogmog is a free browser game where Genesis Chogs power silly chain-reaction machines. Each Chog's real traits decide what it can do:

Every Chog can push and release a ball.
A Fire aura lifts things up.
A Wizard Hat or Wizard Beanie opens a portal.
Laser eyes fire a laser that pops balloons.
Some mouths shout and blow nearby things away.
Bubblegum bounces, Drooling makes things slick, Rainbow Puke sprays and coin mouths drop coins.

HOW IT PLAYS: Open Play and press Run. A ball drops, a laser fires, a balloon pops, confetti floats up through a portal, a lever tips and your banner opens. Change one thing, like where the ball starts or which Chog powers a step, and run it again to see what breaks or what new trick happens. When the run ends, a comic strip replays each step, with sound words like ZAP and POP.

WHY THE NFT MATTERS A Chog's powers come from its real Genesis traits. Swapping the picture alone changes nothing. If you swap the Fire Chog for one without a Fire aura, the lift step fails: its tether unplugs and the chain stops right there. If you take away the laser eyes, the balloon never pops. Who owns a Chog also matters: only the current holder can publish new parts made from it.

HOLDERS AND EVERYONE ELSE

Anyone can play and build for free. You don't need a wallet, an NFT or any tokens.
Build: put parts on the stage, wire them together and run your own machine. Your draft is saved in your browser.
My Chog: a Genesis holder signs in with their wallet and turns their Chog into a reusable part. Signing in only asks you to sign a message. It doesn't cost gas, ask for approvals or move the NFT. A part can only use the powers that Chog's traits give it.
Each published part is a fixed version with the holder's name on it. The name stays even if the Chog is sold later. A new owner can publish new versions but can't change the old ones.
Gallery: parts and machines other players have published, ready to run and reuse in your own machine
No Chog? My Chog has a clearly labelled PREVIEW mode that uses public Chog data, so anyone can try making a part. Preview parts stay in your browser and can never be published or counted as real.
HONEST STATUS Chogmog was built during the Chogathon and is live at https://chogmog.vercel.app. It also works on phones. What hasn't happened yet:

No real Genesis holder has published a part, so the Gallery is still empty.
Wallet sign-in and publishing have been tested with test wallets only, not by a real holder on the live site
We haven't run tests with outside players yet.
We cut optional CHOG tips to creators and in-app video export to fit the time

CREDITS Chog artwork and traits come from the public Genesis collection on Monad. Sounds are from Kenney (CC0), icons from Phosphor and fonts are Dela Gothic One and Atkinson Hyperlegible (OFL). Built solo with AI coding help (Devin). The code is MIT licensed
