projects.gtm_plan:
Community doesn't have to move from current socials. A Club is a layer on top of them that the existing tools can't offer, because each of the following goes against how they earn:

  1. The fees come back to the people who made the market. A traditional marketplace keeps its fee and gives nothing back to the collection.
  2. Active Holders share the Holder pool, and each Club's Owner decides who is paid within protocol bounds: every active Holder, only the most active, or a slice for members without NFTs too.
  3. The Owner can fund the community without a token launch. The Owner claims the Club by proving they own the collection contract. The Club fund collects its share of the fees, sponsors can back any week, and the Owner can run challenges with points, trophies or an NFT prize. They don't have to sell anything or run a sale.
  4. The swap needs no trust. Escrow or signed swaps settle atomically, so "you send first" disappears.

  Each of these gives someone a reason to try it.

THE GROWTH LOOP

  A Holder posts about their Club on X or timeline. A visitor sees a Club with real trades/good rewards, then joins, holds, swaps or posts. Trading fees contribute to the Club's weekly reward pool. The Holder earns a bigger share and posts again.

  What is already built and feeds the loop:
  - Share the week: each Club's weekly recap with the fees and the top Holders' payouts.
  - Holders' own posts count toward the Holder bonus and appear on the Club's Board as cards.
  - Live standings and nudges: a Holder sees their rank, the epoch closing and a prompt to post.
  - Incentives activity to boost engagement: Challenge.

  Every Holder who is rewarded for posting is also marketing the Club, in the one place the community already is.

  The reward doesn't need to be big every week. But some noticable weeks with high volume, sponsors, challenges noise can stir up the market.

ACQUISITION PLAN

Because I'm a solo developer, so there's still a lot of gaps the project need to patch: UI/UX, Contracts, Infrastructure,...

Project state: In two weeks, I built and deployed the initial DeClub testnet product, including the escrow and signed-swap contracts, Club social layer, rewards flow and a repeatable demo environment. Some Chog community members have already tested the app and provided feedback. The next milestone is not more speculative features, but proving repeatable usage with real Owners and members.

I'm a known member of Chog community, so I've contacted Toad (co-founder) to onboard the Chog community on the platform, but currently we're waiting for the Chogtober event to end first (end of October).

Here's the steps that I can plan it our for now:

  Step 1 · Prove it with real Owners
- Talk with real Owners about how our platform can make a change to the community.
- Bring 1-3 Monad Communities to the platform.
- Measure activation, weekly retention, repeat posting, repeat trading and reward claims.
- Identify the minimum activity needed for a Club to feel alive. Determine whether rewards, swaps, challenges or owner funding is the strongest activation trigger. Use those results for grants, angels and team formation.

  Step 2  · Turn the pilot into a repeatable model
- Bring the Step 1 results, a live demo and the unit economics above to angels who know the Monad and NFT scene, and to ecosystem grants and programs.
- Identify the highest-impact gaps that I can't fill, then recruit collaborators or make the first hire to address them. Priorities may include product/UI, community operations, smart-contract security and infrastructure.
- Begin targeted X marketing around real Club activity, weekly recaps, challenges and member rewards—not generic product promotion.
- Use member and Owner feedback to improve the product, external audit and close the operational gaps before mainnet.Trading fees contribute to the Club's weekly reward pool.

  Step 3 · Mainnet, then Clubs by demand
- Launch on Monad mainnet with a small number of verified Clubs whose Owners are actively committed to operating them. Support each Club through its first reward epochs, challenges and sponsored campaigns.
- Sponsor some first weeks for market exposure.
- Improve the Board, posting experience, onboarding and reward flows based on measured usage and retention.
- Add X engagement only if it improves participation without making the reward system easier to farm.
- Add new collections based on demonstrated demand from Owners and communities.

  Step 4 · Beyond Monad
- Bring more EVM chains, make Deals cross-chain, onboard more NFT communities, liquidity to MONAD!!!!
- Explore additional asset categories, such as memecoins or other community-owned assets, if the NFT Club model is proven and the new category has a clear community and economic use case.
- Develop shared identity, reputation and discovery across Clubs and chains without weakening each community's ownership and moderation.

Risks we know about
- Low volume: early fee pools may be small, so Owners and sponsors may need to fund challenges and rewards while a Club grows. The Reward pool is intended to not be big every week.
- Owner dependency: a Club needs an active Owner to bring in its first members and create activity. We will provide an onboarding playbook and test it across multiple communities. Sponsor some of the first weeks might also helps creating community's trusts.
- Trust and security: contracts, rewards and infrastructure must work with real value. We will complete testnet validation, external review, monitoring and staged mainnet launch before scaling.
- Moderation and farming: rewards can attract spam, sybil accounts and wash trading. We design the Reward system with this problem in mind. Signed activity, holding-based limits, caps and moderation reduce—but do not eliminate—this risk.

Chog Dash is a 3D space runner built around the Chog Genesis NFT collection and the $CHOG token on Monad. You fly a rocket through open space as your own Chog, dodge asteroids and debris, collect Stardust and see how far you can go. Speed builds the further you fly, so every run gets harder.

Judges: open Demo mode to play every Chog NFT feature for free, no NFT needed.

Your Chog is your character
- Connect a Monad wallet and the game finds every Chog Genesis NFT you hold. Pick one and it rides the rocket, using its own artwork.
- The Chog's real on-chain traits shape the run:
  - Laser Eyes: 10 shots per run that blast through anything in your path, even huge asteroids.
  - Tier multiplies your distance: Common x1.00 up to Legendary x1.40.
  - The rocket's look comes from its traits: painted in its Background colour, an Aura trail, special Skull and Radioactive rockets, and a unique rocket for each one-of-one Legendary.
- Ownership is checked on-chain when a run starts and again when it's submitted.

Chog careers: the game adds history to the NFT
- Every run builds a career for the Chog token itself, not the wallet.
- Runs earn XP, Chogs level up (up to level 50) and unlock 14 titles, from First Flight and Asteroid Belt Veteran to Weekly Champion.
- Each career keeps the Chog's stats, weekly honors and recent runs, with the pilot who flew each one.
- Sell or trade the NFT and its level, titles and run history go with it, so a played Chog carries a record an unplayed one doesn't.
- Anyone can look up any Chog's career, and levels show on the leaderboard and the run card.

Trait of the week
- Every Monday a different trait is featured, for example Fire Auras, Laser Eyes or Skull & Radioactive rockets.
- Chogs with that trait get +10% total distance for the week, stacked on their tier.
- 12 traits rotate, so different Chogs across the whole collection get their week to shine, not just Legendaries.

The game
- Fast 3D flying with mouse, keyboard or touch controls, built for both desktop and phone.
- 8 pickups: Stardust (every 100 gives an extra life), Golden Horn, Dash, Magnet, Slow-Mo, Nova (clears the screen), Radar and Mystery Box.
- 5 zones that loop and get longer each time: Outer Space, Asteroid Belt, Galactic Drift, Deep Cosmic Zone and the Milky Way, each with its own scenery and obstacles.
- Near misses, extra lives and streak lives give second chances, so one mistake doesn't always end a run.
- Original soundtrack and sound effects, with separate music and effects switches.

Compete every week for real $CHOG
- Tickets: $0.50 in $CHOG per ranked run, bought in-game from the Tickets button. The wallet approves only the exact amount, and a ticket is used when the rocket takes off.
- No ticket? You can still play unranked. Quests, streaks and your Chog's career still count.
- Every ticket's $CHOG goes into a public pool contract on Monad, and the weekly top 10 share it (25/18/13/10/8/7/6/5/4/4%). No fee: 100% goes back to players.
- The leaderboard resets every Monday 00:00 UTC, so every week is a new race. Shares nobody earns roll over to the next week.
- Runs are checked by the server (run time, possible distance, Laser Eyes use) before they're ranked, and results are reviewed before payout.
- The contract has no withdraw function: it only takes $CHOG for tickets and pays finished weeks' winners. Every purchase and payout is a public event on Monad.

Reasons to come back every day
- Daily quests (easy, medium, hard) and a weekly quest, each earning a badge.
- Tiered badges (bronze, silver, gold, platinum) with rarity percentages. Pin your favourite to show it on the leaderboard and your run card.
- A daily streak that banks extra lives: 7 days +1, 14 days +3, 21 days +5.
- Your Chog's level and titles grow with every run, and the trait of the week changes which Chog to fly.
- A shareable run card after every run (X 16:9 or square) with your Chog, its level, distance, zone and badges, plus one-tap share to X.

Three modes
- Practice: anyone can fly right away as Rookie, the practice pilot. No wallet needed.
- Chog NFT: the full game for holders, with tickets, the weekly prize pool, careers and the Chog NFT leaderboard.
- Demo: a full replica of Chog NFT mode, made so anyone, judges included, can play every Chog NFT feature for free. Pick one of 5 real Chog Genesis NFTs (one per tier) and get the same traits, Laser Eyes, tier scoring, trait of the week, careers, quests, badges and streaks. Connect any wallet to compete on the separate DEMO leaderboard. Demo leaves out only the real-money parts.

How it's built
- Front end: Three.js (WebGL) and plain JavaScript, no framework, tuned to run smoothly on phones.
- Chain: Monad mainnet. Ownership checks through batched reads (Multicall3), wallet sign-in with a free signed message, and MetaMask, Rabby and Phantom support.
- Prize pool: a Solidity contract (ChogDashPool), tested with Foundry and on a fork of Monad mainnet with real $CHOG. The $CHOG ticket price comes from the live market.
- Server: Vercel serverless functions with a Supabase database for sign-in, run checks, leaderboards, careers, quests, streaks and tickets.
- The server never holds keys and never moves money. Players pay from their own wallets, and the pool owner pays winners from theirs.

FUD posts become monsters. Your Chog NFT hunts them.

**What it is**
Someone on X says "Monad is a ghost chain". In Chog Contracts that post becomes a monster contract. Its words decide the monster: its name, how strong it is and its weak spot. You send your Chog to hunt it, fight turn by turn, and take the $CHOG bounty. A free browser game, no install, works on phone and desktop.

**Why the Chog NFT is essential**
Take the NFT out and there is no character, no moveset and no story.
- Traits are moves. Every Chog's abilities, element and class are read straight from its on-chain traits on Monad. Bandana? Second Wind. Rainbow mouth? Rainbow Puke. Laser eyes? A laser. No two Chogs fight the same way, so which Chog you hold changes how you play.
- The story lives with the token. Every hunt and expedition is written into that Chog's journal: wins, scars, injuries that need rest, trophies, levels. The journal is stored per token, not per wallet. If the Chog is sold, the new owner inherits its story.
- Holders can earn without playing. List your Chog for hire with one plain-text signature. Other players hunt with it and you keep 30% of every bounty.
- No Chog? You start as the free Wannabe Chog, who dreams of becoming one. It forgets its past every 24 hours, can only explore the backyard and stays off the leaderboard. The game shows what you're missing.

**What makes it new**
- FUD becomes content. Paste any post and the FUD Forge turns it into a monster built from its own words. There is always a new monster to hunt.
- A weekly raid boss with a leaderboard you can't fake. Each boss hunt starts from a server-issued seed. The keys you press are sent back and the whole fight is replayed on the server with the same combat code, so only real damage counts. Everyone fights at level 10 against a boss with triple HP, your score is your best 3 hunts, and each wallet brings one Chog per week. Pure skill.
- Expeditions with hand-written stories. Your Chog meets characters on the map, you make the choice, and the outcome changes what it brings home and what goes into its journal.
- Your Chog has a life outside fights: Wannabe's Room to decorate, an Arcade with Chog mini games, and a Brick Studio that turns your Chog's own art into a buildable brick mosaic with a parts list and a step-by-step booklet.
- Painted arenas for every monster, trait-based special effects, a 3D gate with a WANTED poster for the weekly boss.

**Wallet safety, built in**
The site never asks for a transaction, an approval or a token permit. You prove ownership with a free plain-text signature, or without connecting a wallet at all: paste your address, send a small exact amount of MON from your wallet to the same address, and paste the transaction hash. The MON never leaves your wallet. Smart accounts work too. The site never shows any other address and never asks for a seed phrase. A "What we will never do" section on the site spells this out.

**$CHOG**
Bounties, healing and the 30% rental share are in $CHOG. In this demo they are test values and nothing is paid out yet. A real weekly $CHOG prize pool for the boss leaderboard is built and switched off until it is funded.

**How to test (2 minutes)**
1. Open https://chog-contracts.netlify.app and press Enter the hunt.
2. No Chog? Play right away as the Wannabe Chog: pick a contract under "Take a contract" and fight.
3. Have a Chog? Press Connect wallet. Either sign the free plain-text message, or use "No connect: send MON to yourself". Your Chogs load with their own moves.
4. Hunt the weekly boss with your Chog to get on the live leaderboard. Set your hunter name from the account menu.
5. Send your Chog on an expedition, then try Wannabe's Room, the Arcade and the Brick Studio from the top tabs.

**Pre-existing work and tools**
Everything was built during Chogathon. three.js for 3D, viem for signature and transaction checks. Monster, room, map and arena art made with AI image tools and cut by hand; potion bottles are a Sketchfab model. Built solo by a vibe coder with Claude (Anthropic).

**What's next**
Turning on the weekly $CHOG prize pool for the boss leaderboard (paid automatically each week), real payouts for rentals, PvP between Chogs, community-voted seasonal bosses, and FUD posts pulled live from X.

projects.title: ChogBound
projects.description:
ChogBound: your Chog. Your plan. Your fight.

WHAT IT IS ChogBound is a daily coaching and battle game for Chog Genesis NFTs on Monad. You pick a Chog, coach it by choosing a temperament, a move and how much risk to take, and then you watch its fight in a fighting-game replay with wind-ups, impacts, fighter shouts and music. Every night all 1,969 Chogs fight a rival drawn from the whole collection, and the season standings rank all of them.

You do not control a fighter button by button. You are the coach. You set the plan, the real simulator plays it out, and the Chog's own traits decide how well it goes.

WHAT MAKES IT NEW

The traits are the rules. Every trait value on all 1,969 Chogs is mapped to game rules: 96 bodies, 58 eyes, 66 heads, 15 mouths, 22 auras, 9 accessories and 10 Legendary kits. Bodies and heads change stats, eyes give PUNCH and unlock a signature move (Laser Stare, Scan, Charm, Stare Down, Chaos Gaze), auras and accessories give fight effects (Scorch, Vanish, Calm Glow, Gust, Pump, Lucky Flip, Sidekick), the mouth sets the voice, and tier adds a stat bonus. A different Chog really does play a different game.
It is balanced on the whole collection, not on a sample. We simulated 2,000,000 random fights across all 1,969 Chogs. Token win rates stay between 34.6% and 68.0%, and win rate climbs with tier (about 48%, 52%, 60%, 61% and 64% from Common to Legendary). Rarity helps without deciding everything.
Everything is public and reproducible. The night number comes from the UTC date. A Chog's rival for a night is drawn by a public seeded draw, and every fight uses the seed night:youId:rivalId, so anyone can recompute any result or the whole standings. There is no hidden server state.
It sounds like a fighting game. Each move has its own wind-up, a hit is a crack, a slap and a thud, fighters shout before they strike, a miss is only a whiff, and the music ducks under big hits and gets more intense as health drops.

WHY CHOG MATTERS (THE NFT IS ESSENTIAL) Take the NFT out and there is no game. The Chog's traits are the characters, the stats, the special effects, the voices and the balance. Remove them and there is nothing to fight with.

Holders connect a wallet on Monad, sign a message (no transaction, no gas), and the game reads which Chogs that wallet owns directly from the Chog Genesis contract. Then they coach one of their own Chogs with its real traits.
Every night's draw and the standings cover the whole Chog collection, so each Chog has its own record.
Guest mode lets reviewers try the game without a wallet. It borrows 24 sample Chogs and uses the same real trait data and the same fight engine. It is a trial so anyone can see what a Chog does, and the full experience is playing your own.

WHY PEOPLE COME BACK A new night starts every day at 00:00 UTC with a new rival for every Chog, so there is always a new fight to coach. The arena shows your Chog's rank among 1,969, your record, tonight's rival and a countdown to the next night.

HOW IT WORKS UNDER THE HOOD

TypeScript monorepo. A deterministic fight engine (sim/) with its own test suite and balance tools, and a Next.js 15 app (web/).
viem reads the Chog Genesis contract on Monad mainnet (chain 143). The contract is not enumerable, so ownership is read with Multicall3: all 1,969 owners in 5 requests (about 2 seconds, measured).
Chog art is never stored. Images load in the player's browser from public IPFS gateways, with a drawn placeholder if none answer.
Quality: 99 unit tests, 38 browser tests (Playwright, with a simulated wallet and a simulated Monad node) and CI on every push.

WHAT IS NOT BUILT YET No contract is deployed by this project. On-chain nightly records, ERC-6551 token-bound accounts, a Farcaster Mini App and signed player plans that enter the public standings are planned and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md. The standings use autopilot plans for every Chog so that anyone can reproduce them.

Everything was written for Chogathon 2026. Open source libraries used: Next.js, React, viem, Vitest, Playwright.

projects.title: Chogbound
projects.description:
Chogbound: Your Chog. Your Fight.

Your Chog Genesis NFT shouldn't just sit in your wallet. In Chogbound, it's your fighter.

Chogbound is a pixel-art battle MMO on Monad. You wander a little pixel world alongside other players, walk up to someone, challenge them to a duel, and fight it out in real time. If you're feeling brave, you can put $CHOG on the line. The money sits in an on-chain contract, never with the game.

▶ Play now: https://chogboundv1.up.railway.app

GETTING IN TAKES A MINUTE
1. Connect your wallet and sign one message. It's free: no gas, no transaction. It just proves the wallet is yours.
2. Link your X account. Your @handle becomes your name in the world and on the leaderboard.
3. Hit Play. The game checks which Chogs you hold and drops you into Chogtown with your strongest one already equipped.

A built-in How to Play guide walks you through everything, from controls and staking to the zones and how fairness works.

YOUR CHOG, FOR REAL
Every Chog fights differently, because its stats come straight from its real on-chain traits:
• Head → attack
• Body → defence
• Skin + Body → health
• Background + Aura → speed
• Eyes + Mouth → luck

Rarity sets the power curve. There are six tiers, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic, and the multiplier climbs from ×1.0 to ×1.9. Rarer Chogs also unlock more skill slots, which you fill from a set of general moves: Chog Strike, Slam, Chog Bolt, Snack Bite, Fury Howl and Guard.

Then there's the fun part: every Chog gets one signature move picked from its traits, and it's always equipped. Laser eyes give you Laser Eyes, a piercing beam with a big crit chance. A crown gives you Royal Decree, which heals you mid-fight. There are 15 in total, including Inferno, Death Mark, Smoke Screen, Bubble Shield, Thunder Clap, Pay Day, Backstab and Parallel Strike. Finding out what yours does is half the fun. Hold more than one Chog? Switch between them any time and check each one's full trait card.

NO CHOG? YOU CAN STILL PLAY
Players without an NFT come in as Wanderers. Each one gets a one-of-a-kind outfit generated from their wallet address: a cloak, headwear, eyes, an accessory and something to hold. Wanderers don't get skills, and a few zones are closed to them, but they swing faster than anyone else. A sharp Wanderer can absolutely take down a careless Common Chog. We wanted the game open to everyone, while still making owning a Chog feel like it really matters.

A WORLD WORTH EXPLORING
There are 15 zones, and each one bends the rules of combat:
• Chogtown: the safe hub. Practice fights only, with the Portal Plaza leading everywhere.
• Belever Tor: ancient standing stones, +5% crit.
• Frostmere: duels on cracking ice, where shields block 70%.
• Magma Caldera: everyone burns, and burns hit harder.
• Neon Bazaar: a Monad megacity where luck is boosted.
• Gloomfen: a haunted bog where heals and poisons are both stronger.
• Degen Casino: extreme variance, double luck, pure chaos.
• Lunar Crater, Sky Isles and Colosseum 143: holders only, with bigger crits and bigger damage.
• The Void Rift: Rare Chogs and above only, +50% damage.
…plus Emberwilds, Crystal Caverns, Sunken Temple and Rugpull Dunes.

Walk through glowing portals or fast-travel from the world map. A live counter shows how many players are in each zone, so you can always find a fight, and when a duel starts nearby you'll get a prompt to watch it.

FIGHTS THAT FEEL LIKE FIGHTS
Duels are live, not auto-battles. After a 3-2-1 countdown, you move with WASD or the arrow keys, attack with Space, and fire skills on 1–4, each with its own cooldown. A ring around your fighter shows when you're close enough to land a hit, while bolts and lasers reach further. Shields block hits, smoke lets you dodge, Thunder Clap can stun, and poison and burns tick away at your health. Land a critical hit, watch their bar drain, and take the K.O. before the 90-second clock runs out. On phones you get an on-screen d-pad and tap buttons.

Every win counts as a kill. The leaderboard tracks kills, K/D, your best streak and how much CHOG you've won. A server-wide kill feed calls out every knockout, and the top players show up right on the front page.

STAKE $CHOG, SAFELY
Practice duels are always free. To play for stakes, head to any arena zone, walk up to a rival and pick an amount: 10, 50, 100, 500, or Max, with your balance shown so you don't overreach. Before accepting, your rival sees your Chog, its power, its signature move and that zone's rules. Then it's two wallet confirmations: approve, then stake. Your rival matches the amount, both stakes lock in an on-chain escrow contract, and only then does the fight begin. The winner gets the pot minus a 3% fee, paid out automatically. Example: a 200 CHOG pot pays the winner 194.

The game never holds your money. The contract does. Its address is public and its source is verified:
0x16D687505037a0A3E2B882F2bBa45E772807BEde

Real money means things have to fail gracefully, so we sweated the edge cases:
• Lose your connection mid-fight? You get 15 seconds to jump back into the same duel.
• Duel can't start? Both players get their stakes back in full, usually within a minute.
• Payout system down? Anyone can recover both stakes on-chain after 7 days, right from the in-game menu.
• Sold your Chog mid-session? It can't keep fighting. Ownership is checked again before every duel, so one NFT can never fight from two wallets.
• The 3% fee is locked the moment a challenge is created, and the game won't let you stake if it ever changes.

FAIR, AND YOU CAN CHECK IT
Before every duel, the server locks in a secret random seed and shows you its fingerprint. Both players' browsers add their own randomness. When the fight ends, the server reveals the seed and the recorded moves, and your browser replays the entire fight with the same engine to check the winner. You'll see "✓ INPUT REPLAY VERIFIED" on the results screen. Every staked fight also gets a public page anyone can look up and verify.

REAL PEOPLE ONLY
Requiring X accounts was a deliberate choice: one X account per wallet means the names on the leaderboard are real people, not bot farms.

  - Incentives activity to boost engagement: Challenge.

  Step 1 · Prove it with real Owners
- Talk with real Owners about how our platform can make a change to the community.
- Bring 1-3 Monad Communities to the platform.
- Measure activation, weekly retention, repeat posting, repeat trading and reward claims.
- Identify the minimum activity needed for a Club to feel alive. Determine whether rewards, swaps, challenges or owner funding is the strongest activation trigger. Use those results for grants, angels and team formation.

  Step 2  · Turn the pilot into a repeatable model
- Bring the Step 1 results, a live demo and the unit economics above to angels who know the Monad and NFT scene, and to ecosystem grants and programs.
- Identify the highest-impact gaps that I can't fill, then recruit collaborators or make the first hire to address them. Priorities may include product/UI, community operations, smart-contract security and infrastructure.
- Begin targeted X marketing around real Club activity, weekly recaps, challenges and member rewards—not generic product promotion.
- Use member and Owner feedback to improve the product, external audit and close the operational gaps before mainnet.Trading fees contribute to the Club's weekly reward pool.

  Step 3 · Mainnet, then Clubs by demand
- Launch on Monad mainnet with a small number of verified Clubs whose Owners are actively committed to operating them. Support each Club through its first reward epochs, challenges and sponsored campaigns.
- Sponsor some first weeks for market exposure.
- Improve the Board, posting experience, onboarding and reward flows based on measured usage and retention.
- Add X engagement only if it improves participation without making the reward system easier to farm.
- Add new collections based on demonstrated demand from Owners and communities.

  Step 4 · Beyond Monad
- Bring more EVM chains, make Deals cross-chain, onboard more NFT communities, liquidity to MONAD!!!!
- Explore additional asset categories, such as memecoins or other community-owned assets, if the NFT Club model is proven and the new category has a clear community and economic use case.
- Develop shared identity, reputation and discovery across Clubs and chains without weakening each community's ownership and moderation.

Risks we know about
- Low volume: early fee pools may be small, so Owners and sponsors may need to fund challenges and rewards while a Club grows. The Reward pool is intended to not be big every week.
- Owner dependency: a Club needs an active Owner to bring in its first members and create activity. We will provide an onboarding playbook and test it across multiple communities. Sponsor some of the first weeks might also helps creating community's trusts.
- Trust and security: contracts, rewards and infrastructure must work with real value. We will complete testnet validation, external review, monitoring and staged mainnet launch before scaling.
- Moderation and farming: rewards can attract spam, sybil accounts and wash trading. We design the Reward system with this problem in mind. Signed activity, holding-based limits, caps and moderation reduce—but do not eliminate—this risk.

projects.title: Chog Dash
projects.description:
Chog Dash is a 3D space runner built around the Chog Genesis NFT collection and the $CHOG token on Monad. You fly a rocket through open space as your own Chog, dodge asteroids and debris, collect Stardust and see how far you can go. Speed builds the further you fly, so every run gets harder.

Play: https://chog-dash.vercel.app (desktop and phone browsers, nothing to install)
Judges: open Demo mode to play every Chog NFT feature for free, no NFT needed.

Your Chog is your character
- Connect a Monad wallet and the game finds every Chog Genesis NFT you hold. Pick one and it rides the rocket, using its own artwork.
- The Chog's real on-chain traits shape the run:
  - Laser Eyes: 10 shots per run that blast through anything in your path, even huge asteroids.
  - Tier multiplies your distance: Common x1.00 up to Legendary x1.40.
  - The rocket's look comes from its traits: painted in its Background colour, an Aura trail, special Skull and Radioactive rockets, and a unique rocket for each one-of-one Legendary.
- Ownership is checked on-chain when a run starts and again when it's submitted.

Chog careers: the game adds history to the NFT
- Every run builds a career for the Chog token itself, not the wallet.
- Runs earn XP, Chogs level up (up to level 50) and unlock 14 titles, from First Flight and Asteroid Belt Veteran to Weekly Champion.
- Each career keeps the Chog's stats, weekly honors and recent runs, with the pilot who flew each one.
- Sell or trade the NFT and its level, titles and run history go with it, so a played Chog carries a record an unplayed one doesn't.
- Anyone can look up any Chog's career, and levels show on the leaderboard and the run card.

Trait of the week
- Every Monday a different trait is featured, for example Fire Auras, Laser Eyes or Skull & Radioactive rockets.
- Chogs with that trait get +10% total distance for the week, stacked on their tier.
- 12 traits rotate, so different Chogs across the whole collection get their week to shine, not just Legendaries.

The game
- Fast 3D flying with mouse, keyboard or touch controls, built for both desktop and phone.
- 8 pickups: Stardust (every 100 gives an extra life), Golden Horn, Dash, Magnet, Slow-Mo, Nova (clears the screen), Radar and Mystery Box.
- 5 zones that loop and get longer each time: Outer Space, Asteroid Belt, Galactic Drift, Deep Cosmic Zone and the Milky Way, each with its own scenery and obstacles.
- Near misses, extra lives and streak lives give second chances, so one mistake doesn't always end a run.
- Original soundtrack and sound effects, with separate music and effects switches.

Compete every week for real $CHOG
- Tickets: $0.50 in $CHOG per ranked run, bought in-game from the Tickets button. The wallet approves only the exact amount, and a ticket is used when the rocket takes off.
- No ticket? You can still play unranked. Quests, streaks and your Chog's career still count.
- Every ticket's $CHOG goes into a public pool contract on Monad, and the weekly top 10 share it (25/18/13/10/8/7/6/5/4/4%). No fee: 100% goes back to players.
- The leaderboard resets every Monday 00:00 UTC, so every week is a new race. Shares nobody earns roll over to the next week.
- Runs are checked by the server (run time, possible distance, Laser Eyes use) before they're ranked, and results are reviewed before payout.
- The contract has no withdraw function: it only takes $CHOG for tickets and pays finished weeks' winners. Every purchase and payout is a public event on Monad.

Reasons to come back every day
- Daily quests (easy, medium, hard) and a weekly quest, each earning a badge.
- Tiered badges (bronze, silver, gold, platinum) with rarity percentages. Pin your favourite to show it on the leaderboard and your run card.
- A daily streak that banks extra lives: 7 days +1, 14 days +3, 21 days +5.
- Your Chog's level and titles grow with every run, and the trait of the week changes which Chog to fly.
- A shareable run card after every run (X 16:9 or square) with your Chog, its level, distance, zone and badges, plus one-tap share to X.

Three modes
- Practice: anyone can fly right away as Rookie, the practice pilot. No wallet needed.
- Chog NFT: the full game for holders, with tickets, the weekly prize pool, careers and the Chog NFT leaderboard.
- Demo: a full replica of Chog NFT mode, made so anyone, judges included, can play every Chog NFT feature for free. Pick one of 5 real Chog Genesis NFTs (one per tier) and get the same traits, Laser Eyes, tier scoring, trait of the week, careers, quests, badges and streaks. Connect any wallet to compete on the separate DEMO leaderboard. Demo leaves out only the real-money parts.

How it's built
- Front end: Three.js (WebGL) and plain JavaScript, no framework, tuned to run smoothly on phones.
- Chain: Monad mainnet. Ownership checks through batched reads (Multicall3), wallet sign-in with a free signed message, and MetaMask, Rabby and Phantom support.
- Prize pool: a Solidity contract (ChogDashPool), tested with Foundry and on a fork of Monad mainnet with real $CHOG. The $CHOG ticket price comes from the live market.
- Server: Vercel serverless functions with a Supabase database for sign-in, run checks, leaderboards, careers, quests, streaks and tickets.
- The server never holds keys and never moves money. Players pay from their own wallets, and the pool owner pays winners from theirs.

- No ticket? You can still play unranked. Quests, streaks and your Chog's career still count.

- The leaderboard resets every Monday 00:00 UTC, so every week is a new race. Shares nobody earns roll over to the next week.
- Runs are checked by the server (run time, possible distance, Laser Eyes use) before they're ranked, and results are reviewed before payout.

- Daily quests (easy, medium, hard) and a weekly quest, each earning a badge.

Connect any wallet to compete on the separate DEMO leaderboard. Demo leaves out only the real-money parts.

- Front end: Three.js (WebGL) and plain JavaScript, no framework, tuned to run smoothly on phones.
- Chain: Monad mainnet. Ownership checks through batched reads (Multicall3), wallet sign-in with a free signed message, and MetaMask, Rabby and Phantom support.
- Prize pool: a Solidity contract (ChogDashPool), tested with Foundry and on a fork of Monad mainnet with real $CHOG. The $CHOG ticket price comes from the live market.
- Server: Vercel serverless functions with a Supabase database for sign-in, run checks, leaderboards, careers, quests, streaks and tickets.
- The server never holds keys and never moves money. Players pay from their own wallets, and the pool owner pays winners from theirs.

projects.title: Chog Guardian
projects.description:
Health Trace turns a Chog NFT into a private, interactive health guardian on Monad. Instead of using an NFT only as a profile picture, Health Trace gives each verified Chog an active role in the owner’s daily wellbeing. The experience combines health context, market conditions and Web3 behavior to help users recognize when fatigue, stress or attention overload may affect their decisions.

Users connect their wallet, detect the Chog NFTs they own and choose one as their active Chog Guardian. The selected guardian is remembered for that wallet and becomes the center of a daily care loop.

Health Trace includes:
- A daily Web3 Health Score built from sleep, recovery, screen fatigue and market stress context.
- A Chog Reset Quest with short wellbeing activities such as eye breaks, recovery walks, hydration checks and reflection prompts.
- Daily Care XP, guardian levels and evolving traits.
- A 3x Care XP boost for verified Chog holders.
- Daily guardian recommendations that change with the user’s health and market context.
- Live BTC price and volatility data, together with a Fear & Greed indicator.
- Daily journals for FOMO, FUD and revenge-trading urges.
- Weekly recovery reports and privacy-preserving onchain proofs.
- Wallet-specific history, streaks, rewards and progress.

A wallet without a Chog can access the basic health dashboard, but it cannot activate a guardian, access Chog Reset Quests, receive the 3x Care XP boost, develop guardian traits or claim a Weekly Chog Recovery Proof. Chog ownership is therefore essential to the full product loop.


Privacy is central to the experience. Raw sleep, heart-rate, stress and journal information remains offchain. Onchain claims contain only a high-level summary hash and proof state, allowing users to demonstrate healthy actions without publishing sensitive health data.

Progress belongs to the user’s wallet rather than the NFT. Selling or transferring a Chog does not transfer the previous owner’s private health history.

The current hackathon build uses simulated health-source connections for demonstrating the daily wellness experience. NFT ownership verification, wallet interactions, market feeds and Monad proof transactions are real.

Health Trace makes Chog a companion users return to every day: not merely something they own, but something that helps them pause, recover and make better decisions.

projects.description:
Chog State turns every Chog NFT into a living cultural identity.

Most NFTs are born and then frozen. They stay the same picture forever. They never get to live. Chog State is different.

Chog was born from a failed AI experiment. Everyone still loved him. This project takes that origin seriously. You run risky experiments on a Chog. Most of them fail — and that is intentional. Every failure leaves a permanent scar on that specific token. The scars stack. The Weirdness score rises. The Chronicle grows. The Chog’s name and identity change over time.

When the NFT is sold, the entire history moves with it. The buyer does not just receive an image. They inherit the life the Chog has lived.

How it works:
• Pick an experiment and a risk level (Careful, Normal, or Reckless)
• Hold the button
• Most experiments fail and leave a visible scar
• Rare breakthroughs and milestones also get written into the Chronicle
• Every result shows the exact odds and the roll — nothing is hidden, no AI decides the outcome.

The Chog NFT is not a key that unlocks the experience. It is the experience itself.
Only the real owner can run experiments on a token. The history is stored against the token ID. Other apps can later read that history.

Demo Mode lets anyone try the full loop without a wallet. Real wallet mode writes the scars on-chain on Monad testnet.

We are nothing without our history.
Now neither is Chog.

This is Chog State.

projects.title: The Chog World
projects.description:
Chog World is a pixel-art MMORPG on Monad where your Chog Genesis NFT is your character. Connect your wallet, sign a free login message, pick one of your Chogs and step into a living town shared in real time with every other holder: walk, work, trade, build, gamble and hang out together.

YOUR NFT, PLAYABLE
Every Chog Genesis piece is playable with its own look: classic Chogs, Skulls, Radioactives and the 1:1s, each with hand-drawn walk animations in four directions. Traits are not just cosmetic, they shape how you play:
- Laser eyes you can switch on to zap the Chogs in front of you.
- Creatures of the night (Skulls, Radioactives) that never get tired after dark.
- Chogs that can walk on water, crowned Chogs that can take the Mystery Crown, Chog-themed traits that open Chog chests.
- "Plumber" Chogs that can be hired in restaurants, "Left" sided Chogs that can deal at the roulette.
- Coin holders who unlock the high-roller bets at the casino.
1:1s can do everything. Rarer pieces and $CHOG holdings also boost the XP you earn, and you can switch between your Chogs at any time.

A TOWN THAT RUNS ON ITS PLAYERS
- Gather wood, crops and fish, complete daily quests and level up to unlock new perks.
- Sell your goods on market stalls to other players at your own prices.
- Buy land, build a house, furnish it and choose who can come in.
- Own and run a business: the restaurant has stock, preparation stations, a menu, tables to serve and staff hired through an in-game job board with real payroll.
- Buy a car, park it anywhere and drive around town.
- Make friends, chat, rate other players and build a reputation.

THE CASINO
The casino is the beating heart of the town, and it is run by players, not by a script.

Roulette with real dealers. Every roulette table needs a dealer, and the dealer is a player: only Chogs with the "Left" side trait can be hired for the job. The dealer opens the table, calls "no more bets" and spins the wheel. Several players sit at the same table, place their chips on the same layout during the betting time, watch the same spin and get paid at the same moment. The house edge goes to the casino as a business, so dealing is a real job in the town's economy. High-roller chips are reserved for Coin holders.

Slot machines. Classic slots with a ladder of bets, the biggest ones reserved for Coin holders.

Trading floor. The casino has trading PCs that open a full-screen retro desktop with live candlestick charts, zoom and pan, a feed of every trade, open positions and leaderboards. Players go long or short with up to 50x leverage, set their margin, and close in profit or get liquidated.

What makes it unique is what you trade and what moves the price:
- The markets come from the collection itself. Besides $CHOG, BTC and MON, every token is themed on a Chog Genesis trait family: $RETARD, $MANGA, $HORNY, $BUBBLE, $PEACE, $SEA, $GOLD, $CLOWN. Your traits are your trading licence: a Chog with a Gold Tooth or Golden Armor unlocks $GOLD, a Duck Float or Shark Suit unlocks $SEA, a Clown nose unlocks $CLOWN, and so on. Any piece in your wallet counts, not only the one you play. $CHOG is open to everyone, and 1:1s and Candle Chogs unlock every market.
- The price is made by the players. $CHOG, BTC and MON start from their real market price, then live their own life inside the game. Every position a player opens or closes pushes the price, like on a real automated market: deep markets move slowly, small trait tokens move a lot, which makes them the playground of the degens. A light background noise keeps charts alive when nobody trades, but the big moves are always the players. When the price runs, over-leveraged positions get liquidated in cascade and the move feeds itself.
- Candle Chogs play their side of the market: a Green Candle gets +15% on long gains and 15% softer losses, a Red Candle the same on shorts, within a daily cap.
- Players can launch their own token. For 100,000 MX (burned), anyone can list a new ticker with its own name and color. It gets its own market, chart and trade feed, open to every trader in town. Trading fees are burned too, which keeps the in-game economy healthy.

LIVE EVENTS
A day and night cycle, the Mystery Crown hunt, Chog chests hidden around the map, a daily wheel of fortune, double-XP weeks, leaderboards and an in-game radio. Players without a Chog can still enter as spectators, follow any player around town, even inside buildings, and see the world before they join.

BUILT FOR REAL PLAY
Chog World is a real-time, server-authoritative game: every action, bet and trade is validated by the server, so nobody can cheat their balance or their position. Wallet ownership is proven with Sign-In with Ethereum: no transaction, no gas, no token approval, the game only ever reads the chain. One wallet plays in one place at a time.

COMING NEXT
Two features are already planned and on their way:
- $CHOG into $MX. Players will be able to convert $CHOG into $MX, the in-game currency, to buy skins, cars, houses and items. The conversion is one-way, like V-Bucks: $MX never converts back to $CHOG, which keeps the game economy closed and gives $CHOG a real, recurring use inside the game. The conversion screen is already in the game; the on-chain transfer to a game vault verified by the server is the next step.
- Partner collections. Other Monad NFT collections will join the world as playable characters, drawn in the game's style, with their own traits turned into perks and their own trait tokens on the trading floor. Their holders share the same town and the same economy, and since $CHOG is the way into that economy, every new community brings new demand and new liquidity to $CHOG.

Chog World is live today at chog.world

projects.gtm_plan:
THE VISION
Chog World starts as the home of the Chog Genesis collection and grows into an open world on Monad where NFT holders live a second life: a job, a house, a car, a reputation, and stories that players write together. Think of a cozy pixel GTA where every character is an NFT and every system is run by players.

WHO IT IS FOR
- Chog Genesis holders first: their pieces finally have a place to live, to be shown off and to be used. Traits become perks, rarity becomes status.
- $CHOG holders and the wider Monad community, who can watch the world as spectators before they pick up a Chog to play.
- Holders of partner collections, who will bring their own characters into the same world.

WHERE WE ARE
The beta is live at chog.world and open to every holder. The core loop is in place: gathering, quests and levels, a player market, land and houses, a restaurant run by its owner and staff, cars, friends and reputation, live events, and a full casino with multiplayer roulette, slots and a trading floor whose prices are driven by the players. We ship updates continuously, straight to production, based on feedback from the community.

ROADMAP

1. $CHOG becomes the door to the in-game economy
Players will convert $CHOG into $MX, the in-game currency, to buy skins, cars, houses, furniture and items. The conversion is one-way, like V-Bucks: $MX never converts back to $CHOG. This keeps the game economy closed and fair, avoids turning the game into a cash-out machine, and gives $CHOG a real, recurring use: every new player and every big purchase means $CHOG flowing into the game. The conversion screen is already in the game; the on-chain part, a transfer to a game vault verified by the server, is the next step. On the other side, $MX already has strong sinks (trading fees and token launches are burned), so the currency keeps its value as the world grows.

2. Partner collections, more players, more liquidity on $CHOG
We will open Chog World to other Monad NFT collections as playable characters. Each partner collection gets its characters drawn in the game's style, its own traits turned into perks, and its own trait tokens on the casino trading floor. Their holders join the same town, the same economy and the same events. Since $CHOG is the way into the in-game economy, every new community that joins brings new demand and new liquidity to $CHOG. Each partnership comes with co-marketing: launch events, exclusive skins and rewards for both communities.

3. New maps and mechanics: the long-term vision
This is where we want to take the world over time. These ideas are still at the concept stage: none of them is designed or built yet, and their final shape will depend on what players enjoy most. The town was built to grow district by district, and each new building would come with its own jobs, businesses and gameplay. Some of the directions we are excited about:
- A nightclub: a player-owned venue with a DJ booth, a bar served by staff and nightly events.
- A bank: deposits, loans and a vault holding in-game money, with bankers hired among the players.
- Heists: crews of players could try to rob the bank or the casino and escape with the cash, which would give owners a reason to hire security.
- Police: officers played by players, who could chase robbers through the streets by car, investigate and make arrests.
- More jobs, such as security guard, detective, mechanic or taxi driver, so that each new building creates new interactions between players.
The long-term ambition is an open world with endless possibilities, in the spirit of GTA: no fixed storyline, just systems that meet and players who make the stories.

4. Early ideas to bring players back every day
These are early-stage ideas, not designed or built yet. We share them to show the direction we want to explore, and they will be shaped with the community:
- Seasons with leaderboards and rewards, for example richest trader or best business.
- Crews or guilds that could own businesses together.
- A richer event calendar on top of the events already in the game (Mystery Crown hunts, Chog chests, double-XP weeks), such as casino tournaments or community events.
- Mobile and touch support.

BUSINESS MODEL
- Conversion fee. When players convert $CHOG into $MX, a small fee on each conversion goes to the team. It is the main revenue of the project: it grows with the number of players and with how much they spend in game, and it funds development, servers and new content.
- Partner integration fee. Collections that want their NFTs playable in Chog World pay an integration fee. It covers the work of bringing a collection in: drawing its characters in the game's style, turning its traits into perks, adding its trait tokens to the trading floor and running the launch event.
- In-game items as NFTs (long term). Further out, we want to explore turning key in-game assets into NFTs: Chog Chests, houses, shops, restaurants and other buildings. Players would truly own their property, trade it on the open market and carry its value beyond the game, and each mint and secondary sale would bring revenue to the project. - Holders first: the collection is the core community and the first source of feedback, content and word of mouth.
- Spectator mode as a funnel: anyone can watch the live world without a wallet, follow a player or see the whole map. Curiosity turns into holders.
- Built for streaming and social clips: casino wins, liquidations, police chases and heists make great moments to share on X, and spectator mode lets anyone watch a streamer's character live.
- Referral system already in the game: players invite friends with their own referral link and get rewarded.
- Partner collections bring their communities, and each partnership is a launch event.
- Regular updates shared publicly, with the community voting on the next districts and jobs.

WHY IT LASTS
The economy runs on players, not on emissions: businesses, jobs, the market and the trading floor create value between players, while burns keep $MX healthy and $CHOG conversion brings fresh value in. Every new map adds jobs, every new job adds players who need each other, and every new collection adds a community. The world gets richer as it grows.

projects.title: ChogSignal Arena
projects.description:
ChogSignal Arena — Investigate the Signal. Verify the Chain.

ChogSignal Arena is an evidence-driven on-chain investigation platform that turns bonding-curve activity into a structured forensic experience, with the Chog Genesis NFT at the center of investigator access.

Trading activity can move around the clock, while dashboards, cached APIs, reference-market schedules, and fee configurations can make the underlying picture harder to interpret. ChogSignal Arena helps users investigate these signals by comparing publicly readable on-chain state with upstream market data and organizing findings into clear, evidence-based cases.

 Three forensic investigations

- Curve Graduation & Reserve Proof: Examine curve reserves, target thresholds, graduation state, and reported market progress. Compare on-chain readings against the upstream board API and surface numerical discrepancies without assuming an unproven cause.
- Reference-Market Timing: Explore the relationship between continuous curve trading and traditional market sessions, making timing context visible when interpreting activity.
- Creator Fee-Tier Audit: Inspect publicly readable fee-tier configuration and classify the observed settings without making unsupported claims about intent.

 The Chog NFT as an investigator credential

ChogSignal Arena connects Chog Genesis NFT ownership on Monad Mainnet with a deeper forensic experience for curve analysis on Robinhood Chain Testnet. In the real-user flow, wallet verification and NFT ownership gate the Forensic Lens. The Lens presents technical evidence such as raw calldata, encoded values, and mathematical proof details.

Judges can also explore a clearly labeled, isolated Judge Mode using simulated fixtures. Simulated results are not represented as live on-chain events or proof of NFT ownership.

Built for transparent investigation

The application uses read-only blockchain inspection and public market data to help users reason about what the evidence supports and what remains unverified. It does not launch tokens, custody assets, or execute transactions.

ChogSignal Arena makes the Chog NFT more than a collectible: it becomes the key to an evidence-driven investigation experience.

Inspect the evidence. Verify the signal. Follow the chain.

Live app: https://chogsignal-arena.vercel.app

Your Chog is more than art. It’s proof you showed up early and stayed. Graduation Scout turns it into a passport for every vibe/vibe launch.

Chog Genesis lives on Monad; your trades live on vibe/vibe. It’s the same wallet on both, so when you join, Scout reads your Chogs straight from Monad. No bridge, no Monad signature. The moment you hold a Chog, your score rises, and it rises again after 30 days of holding. Diamond-handed Chogs rise to the top.

For creators, Scout adds the Chog Holders recipe: 60% of a graduation airdrop goes to Chogs who don’t dump, 25% more to long-time Chogs, and 15% to proven holders. Chogs who flip, rug or farm with extra wallets still get nothing. Every score shows its reasons, so nobody wonders why.

Today, airdrops reward speed. On one real vibe/vibe launch, 70 of 100 early buyers sold most of their tokens within an hour, and a snapshot would have paid them all. Scout pays the Chogs who stay instead.

It’s live and real: our token $SCOUT graduated, and Scout paid its airdrop on-chain to 183 wallets, verifiable by anyone.

Your Chog. Your passport. Your airdrop.

• Creators on vibe/vibe who want their graduation airdrop to build a community, not hand exit liquidity to flippers and wallet farms.

• Holders and Chogs, who get rewarded for staying instead of for being fast.

• NFT communities like Chog, whose members gain a portable reputation that follows them into every new launch.

How it grows

• Chog first. Chog Genesis holders are a ready-made, sybil-resistant community: each Chog costs real money, so farms can’t fake them. The Chog Holders recipe gives creators an instant way to reward them, and every Chog who joins makes the next drop more valuable.

• Creator by creator. A creator who uses Scout publishes a locked, verifiable policy. Holders who got paid tell others, and the next creator copies the recipe. Every drop’s aftermath (who held, who sold) feeds back into the next score, so Scout gets sharper with each launch.

projects.title: Plumpy and the Purple Moon
projects.description:
Plumpy and the Purple Moon is a voiced tower-stacking story game where every block is a real Chog Genesis NFT.

The Bear stole every crumb in Chog World, locked 50 Chogs in cages and hired 50 NFT villains to guard them. You play Plumpy, a round little Chog born from a fallen star, and you stack your squad into a tower tall enough to reach each cage. Reach the line and Plumpy climbs up and smashes the cage, then the freed Chog fights the villain in a tap-timing duel. Win, and that Chog joins your squad for every level after.

How it plays

• Tap to drop. Land dead centre for a PERFECT and chain PERFECTs into combos.
• Feed a Chog a rug and it gets fatter: wider and steadier at the bottom, risky at the top.

• The $CHOG market fights back: pumps, whale buys, sell-offs, liquidity freezes, FUD storms and rug pulls hit the tower every few drops, then a FINAL CANDLE when you reach the goal.

• 50 levels across 8 worlds with their own physics: ice, wind, tilted and moving plates, fog, moon gravity, heavy gravity, and a Bear who bites the plate.

• The 53 Chogs in the game are real Chog Genesis tokens on Monad, with their real art and traits from the collection's metadata.
• Traits decide the physics: head shape sets how a Chog stacks (caps are flat, horns are pointy), rarity sets weight (Skulls are heavy), and auras and accessories give powers (windproof, never freezes, ignores sell-offs, sticky landings, golden crumbs).
• Every caged Chog links to the real token on OpenSea, so the game doubles as a tour of the collection.
• The 50 villains are real NFTs too, from 21 collections across Monad, Ethereum, Solana, Abstract and Ronin (Molandaks, The Daks, skrumpeys, Kapysh, Chewy, Mouch, Pudgy Penguins, Mad Lads, Azuki and more). Each has its own lair, music, lines and a pet that carries the plate.

• A fully voiced story: 711 acted lines across 21 character voices, with 43 sound effects placed on the words.
• Practice levels and a coach teach the controls in under a minute.
• Three modes per level (Normal, Degen, Speedrun) for 150 challenges, plus daily quests, a daily $CHOG mood that changes the market, a daily bounty level, boosters bought with crumbs, ranks, stars and an Endless mode.
• Every collapse prints a WANTED poster with a ready-made post for X.
• A real web app: install it to the home screen on iPhone, Android or desktop, play offline, and progress saves itself. A save code moves it to another device.
• No wallet needed to play. No approvals. Ever.

projects.title: DeClub
projects.description:
DeClub gives Monad NFT collection a Club: an open Board signed by its members, a community's engagement ranking, weekly rewards in MON, and its own swap market whose fees pay for those rewards.
CHOG Genesis NFT collection gets a Club, and Chogs are used for making deals. $CHOG can be used for making deals as well. And I'm an insider Monald who's gonna give CHOG the top 1 Club on the leaderboard :D.
User can swap NFTs <-> NFTs <-> any ERC-20 token.
BENEFITS
- Holders: earn real MON for taking part; own their social graph.
- Owners: ready-made community home and funding, no token.
- Traders: swaps, bundles, trait requests and rings that floor-price marketplaces don't offer.
- Ecosystem: a layer on top of Discord/X/marketplaces, with a growth loop for the community (Holders share their Club on X, visitors join, trade, fees grow the pool).
projects.author: @Mafia__Interlet
projects.gtm_plan:
Community doesn't have to move from current socials. A Club is a layer on top of them that the existing tools can't offer, because each of the following goes against how they earn:

  1. The fees come back to the people who made the market. A traditional marketplace keeps its fee and gives nothing back to the collection.
  2. Active Holders share the Holder pool, and each Club's Owner decides who is paid within protocol bounds: every active Holder, only the most active, or a slice for members without NFTs too.
  3. The Owner can fund the community without a token launch. The Owner claims the Club by proving they own the collection contract. The Club fund collects its share of the fees, sponsors can back any week, and the Owner can run challenges with points, trophies or an NFT prize. They don't have to sell anything or run a sale.
  4. The swap needs no trust. Escrow or signed swaps settle atomically, so "you send first" disappears.

  Each of these gives someone a reason to try it.

THE GROWTH LOOP

  A Holder posts about their Club on X or timeline. A visitor sees a Club with real trades/good rewards, then joins, holds, swaps or posts. Trading fees contribute to the Club's weekly reward pool. The Holder earns a bigger share and posts again.

  What is already built and feeds the loop:
  - Share the week: each Club's weekly recap with the fees and the top Holders' payouts.
  - Holders' own posts count toward the Holder bonus and appear on the Club's Board as cards.
  - Live standings and nudges: a Holder sees their rank, the epoch closing and a prompt to post.
  - Incentives activity to boost engagement: Challenge.

  Every Holder who is rewarded for posting is also marketing the Club, in the one place the community already is.

  The reward doesn't need to be big every week. But some noticable weeks with high volume, sponsors, challenges noise can stir up the market.

ACQUISITION PLAN

Because I'm a solo developer, so there's still a lot of gaps the project need to patch: UI/UX, Contracts, Infrastructure,...

Project state: In two weeks, I built and deployed the initial DeClub testnet product, including the escrow and signed-swap contracts, Club social layer, rewards flow and a repeatable demo environment. Some Chog community members have already tested the app and provided feedback. The next milestone is not more speculative features, but proving repeatable usage with real Owners and members.

I'm a known member of Chog community, so I've contacted Toad (co-founder) to onboard the Chog community on the platform, but currently we're waiting for the Chogtober event to end first (end of October).

Here's the steps that I can plan it our for now:

  Step 1 · Prove it with real Owners
- Talk with real Owners about how our platform can make a change to the community.
- Bring 1-3 Monad Communities to the platform.
- Measure activation, weekly retention, repeat posting, repeat trading and reward claims.
- Identify the minimum activity needed for a Club to feel alive. Determine whether rewards, swaps, challenges or owner funding is the strongest activation trigger. Use those results for grants, angels and team formation.

  Step 2  · Turn the pilot into a repeatable model
- Bring the Step 1 results, a live demo and the unit economics above to angels who know the Monad and NFT scene, and to ecosystem grants and programs.
- Identify the highest-impact gaps that I can't fill, then recruit collaborators or make the first hire to address them. Priorities may include product/UI, community operations, smart-contract security and infrastructure.
- Begin targeted X marketing around real Club activity, weekly recaps, challenges and member rewards—not generic product promotion.
- Use member and Owner feedback to improve the product, external audit and close the operational gaps before mainnet.Trading fees contribute to the Club's weekly reward pool.

  Step 3 · Mainnet, then Clubs by demand
- Launch on Monad mainnet with a small number of verified Clubs whose Owners are actively committed to operating them. Support each Club through its first reward epochs, challenges and sponsored campaigns.
- Sponsor some first weeks for market exposure.
- Improve the Board, posting experience, onboarding and reward flows based on measured usage and retention.
- Add X engagement only if it improves participation without making the reward system easier to farm.
- Add new collections based on demonstrated demand from Owners and communities.

  Step 4 · Beyond Monad
- Bring more EVM chains, make Deals cross-chain, onboard more NFT communities, liquidity to MONAD!!!!
- Explore additional asset categories, such as memecoins or other community-owned assets, if the NFT Club model is proven and the new category has a clear community and economic use case.
- Develop shared identity, reputation and discovery across Clubs and chains without weakening each community's ownership and moderation.

Risks we know about
- Low volume: early fee pools may be small, so Owners and sponsors may need to fund challenges and rewards while a Club grows. The Reward pool is intended to not be big every week.
- Owner dependency: a Club needs an active Owner to bring in its first members and create activity. We will provide an onboarding playbook and test it across multiple communities. Sponsor some of the first weeks might also helps creating community's trusts.
- Trust and security: contracts, rewards and infrastructure must work with real value. We will complete testnet validation, external review, monitoring and staged mainnet launch before scaling.
- Moderation and farming: rewards can attract spam, sybil accounts and wash trading. We design the Reward system with this problem in mind. Signed activity, holding-based limits, caps and moderation reduce—but do not eliminate—this risk.

projects.title: ChogSwipe
projects.description:
Chogswipe is a Spy vs Spy-style heist game for Chog holders on Monad. Connect a wallet holding a Chog and its NFT traits become its gadgets: eyes scout for traps, hats pick locks, bodies set your speed, accessories are one-shot specials, and rarity sets how strong they are.
Every holder runs a hideout. Pick a floor plan, hide traps, and stake $CHOG in your onchain vault. Then raid other holders: sneak past guards and traps, swipe up to 10% of their vault, and get back out the front door before the clock runs out.
Defending pays. Every raider puts up a ticket from their own stake when the raid opens. Catch them and the ticket is yours. Every staked hideout also earns a share of 5% of every successful swipe in the game, and claiming it compounds it into the vault.
Every raid is replayed by the referee server and settled on Monad. Raided hideouts get a shield, and owners can watch replays of every raid on them. Between raids, holders warm up on 7 lore heists with their own layouts, plus a daily heist with a leaderboard.

projects.title: ChogSwipe
projects.description:
Chogswipe is a Spy vs Spy-style heist game for Chog holders on Monad. Connect a wallet holding a Chog and its NFT traits become its gadgets: eyes scout for traps, hats pick locks, bodies set your speed, accessories are one-shot specials, and rarity sets how strong they are.
Every holder runs a hideout. Pick a floor plan, hide traps, and stake $CHOG in your onchain vault. Then raid other holders: sneak past guards and traps, swipe up to 10% of their vault, and get back out the front door before the clock runs out.
Defending pays. Every raider puts up a ticket from their own stake when the raid opens. Catch them and the ticket is yours. Every staked hideout also earns a share of 5% of every successful swipe in the game, and claiming it compounds it into the vault.
Every raid is replayed by the referee server and settled on Monad. Raided hideouts get a shield, and owners can watch replays of every raid on them. Between raids, holders warm up on 7 lore heists with their own layouts, plus a daily heist with a leaderboard.

projects.title: superchog
projects.description:
SuperChog, "Chog World Order", is a monthly competitive speedrun platformer for Chog Genesis NFT holders on Monad.

Your NFT is your character and your ticket in:
- All 1,969 Chogs are playable. Each one is rendered as its own pixel character, built from its on-chain traits (hair, headwear, eyewear, outfit), so you run the level as your Chog.
- Rarity sets your lives: a 1/1 gets 5 lives, rank 2–500 gets 4, 501–1000 gets 3, 1001–1500 gets 2 and 1501+ gets 1. Lives stack across every Chog you hold and reset each month.
- Burn 690 $CHOG for +1 life. That's a permanent token sink, tied directly to play.

The run: four levels that follow the Chog story from 2023 to Chog World Order. Each ends in a boss fight and a rescue, all against one clock. The fastest verified clear of the month wins the prize pool.

Built to be fair and safe:
- Wallets connect with a free Sign-In with Ethereum message. No approvals, no token permissions, no transactions requested by the site.
- Every run is recorded as a deterministic input log and replayed frame-by-frame on the server before it reaches the leaderboard, so times can't be faked.
- Each Chog counts for one wallet per month, which stops lives being farmed by passing NFTs around.

Live today: wallet gate, rarity-based lives, $CHOG burn for lives, four levels with bosses, a public leaderboard (finishers plus everyone still in the run) and the Hall of Fame.

projects.tech_stack: Vanilla JavaScript + HTML5 Canvas (custom deterministic game engine), Vercel Serverless Functions (Node.js), Neon Postgres, Monad mainnet RPC, viem, Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) + EIP-1271, Wallet
projects.gtm_plan:
Audience: the 1,969 Chog Genesis holders and the $CHOG community on Monad, then the wider Monad gaming community.

Retention loop:
- A new season every month. Lives reset, the board resets, and a new prize pool goes up.
- Rarity gives holders a lasting reason to keep and upgrade their Chogs.
- Every extra attempt burns $CHOG, so engagement feeds the token.

Launch:
- Chog community Spaces and X threads with top-run clips.
- Weekly leaderboard shoutouts and a "Hall of Fame" across seasons.
- Monad community meetups (Mumbai, around Devcon).

Growth:
- Collab seasons with other Monad projects: sponsored prize pools, guest bosses, partner-NFT cameo skins.
- Creator speedrun challenges.
- Mobile touch polish.

Sustainability: a holder- and sponsor-funded prize pool, with the $CHOG burn as a built-in sink. The infrastructure is serverless and low-cost, so it scales with seasons.

projects.title: ChogWorks
projects.description:
ChogWorks turns community participation into shared rewards and gives Chog Genesis NFTs a practical role beyond a profile picture.

Advertisers create funded campaigns for actions on X, Discord, Telegram, or websites. Users complete quests, earn points, and receive a proportional share of the weekly reward pool.

Campaign funds are split into 80% reward escrow, 10% team fees, and 10% sent to a burn address. Only the portion corresponding to completed tasks contributes to rewards; unused escrow can be refunded when the creator closes and settles a campaign.

Chog Genesis holders unlock an upgradeable points miner. Mining and daily check-in bonuses together contribute no more than 20% of a user's quest points to their reward score, keeping completed work at the center of the economy.

Users sign in with Google or email and receive an embedded wallet. CHOG ownership is checked on Monad. Holders can prove control through a small MON transfer to their own embedded wallet, including supported internal transfers, without connecting their NFT wallet to the site.

The MVP includes campaign creation, quest completion, daily streaks, holder verification, mining, upgrades, a weekly leaderboard, campaign settlement and refunds, and smart-contract reward claims.

Current demo:
• Payments and rewards use test $WORK on Robinhood Chain Testnet.
• The planned production token is $CHOG.
• Social profiles are entered manually. Social API verification is not integrated yet; test completions are credited after the Go/Verify cooldown and remain subject to manual spot checks.
• Weekly distributions are published by the admin after settlement; users claim their rewards onchain.
• Transfers to the burn address do not reduce ERC20 totalSupply.

Built for Chogathon as a working testnet MVP.

Start with a small pilot in the Chog community, bringing together Chog Genesis holders, active community members, and projects seeking measurable participation.

Recruit initial advertisers from ecosystem projects and community creators. Run limited campaigns, collect user feedback, and measure task completion, advertiser repeat usage, retention, and disputed completions.

Before a production launch, integrate supported social APIs, strengthen account-abuse controls, independently review the contracts, and validate the reward economy with pilot data.

The planned production version will use $CHOG. Advertisers fund campaigns, participants share rewards for completed work, and Chog Genesis holders receive access to the miner. Growth will focus on useful campaigns and repeat advertiser demand.
